name: Dr. Asif Mahmood
subject: Here’s why I came to the United States, and I’ll fight to protect its promise:
disclaimer_text: Paid for by VPP
body:
| Friend,

[**This is a long but very important email about my upbringing and why I am running Congress. I hope you'll take a moment to read the entire email, then consider splitting $10 between my campaign and Voter Protection Project to fight for an America that upholds our values and where all are welcome.**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/28907?t=6&akid=4854%2E878179%2EXqRpGD) | [SPLIT $10 NOW »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/28907?t=7&akid=4854%2E878179%2EXqRpGD)
---
[](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/28907?t=8&akid=4854%2E878179%2EXqRpGD)
_With my graduating medical school class in Pakistan._
I was raised in a rural village in Eastern Pakistan.

I loved my community, but I learned early on our society had deep issues.

You couldn't imagine the hatred many held for the Jewish and LGBTQ communities. And when I was growing up, school was just for boys. Women either could not attend or were discouraged from doing so.

Like so many who come to America, I wanted a better life. It was especially important for me to raise my children in a place that valued freedom and the equality of every person -- free of the strict rules I had to abide by as a kid.

After earning my medical degree in 1991, I immigrated to Lexington, Kentucky to pursue a career in medicine.

I have a deep appreciation for the freedoms and opportunities provided in this country -- and not a day goes by that I don't work to give back.

In addition to my medical practice, I have played leading roles with organizations like **UNICEF** and the **Valley Rescue Mission** to eliminate poverty, hunger, and homelessness across Southern California. And if any patient comes to my practice without insurance, we don't ask for payment.

**I'm running for Congress because everything that made the United States the _"City upon a Hill"_ I immigrated to is crumbling in front of us. Our rights and freedoms are being picked apart by radicals. Here in Orange County, extremism and outright racism are at all-time highs.**

Our district is home to one of the largest Asian communities in the country, yet our incumbent Congresswoman Young Kim refuses to speak out against the spike in anti-Asian hate incidents we've faced. Friend, we can't expect to uphold and protect our values as Americans when politicians make their careers by sowing hate and division.

I know more than most that we are trending in the wrong direction, and I refuse to sit on the sidelines -- not with our children's future at stake. That's why I'm in this race and asking for your support:
[**I know we can win this race. It's going to take a lot of grassroots support from across our OC community and beyond. Will you split $10 between my campaign and Voter Protection Project to flip CA-40 and restore compassion and unity to this district and Congress?**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/28907?t=9&akid=4854%2E878179%2EXqRpGD)
If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Dr. Asif Mahmood and VPP will go through immediately:

This is what the American entrepreneurial spirit is all about — a family-owned small business that brings economic growth and social good to its community.

**MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike’s father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father’s arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman’s General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

As a child, Mike attended his father’s arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property. After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Cheri won tonight’s debate!
#

Cheri won tonight’s debate!
She made us all proud and made clear the stakes of this election — and the threats posed by Ted Budd’s extreme agenda.
But now, we need to finish this campaign strong and get our message in front of every North Carolina voter that we can.
[**Can you contribute $3 to our campaign to say you stand with Cheri and help us turn out the voters that we need to win? We’re going to send her a list of everybody who donates in the next 24 hours.**](https://act.cheribeasley.com/go/2567?c0=cb-em-oct22.I3buyh&refcode=em221007-3-MA&t=1&akid=1970%2E357359%2ExZ8lkA)
Tonight, Cheri shared her vision for a brighter future — where every single person has the chance to thrive. She made clear that she would be the kind of Senator North Carolina deserves — a leader who listens and gives a voice to the people. She will make sure that nobody is counted out or forgotten.
Cheri also laid out the facts about our opponent — including his support for a nationwide abortion ban without exceptions and his vote to overturn the election on January 6. She made clear that we do not have to settle for a corrupt insider who will sell his vote to corporate special interests and the billionaires who fund his super PACs.
Sadly, Ted Budd failed to defend his record. Instead, he spent his time attacking Cheri with lies and trying to smear her record of public service.
This is just what we’ve come to expect from our opponent and his dark money allies. It’s what’s so broken about our politics, and it’s gross. But we don’t have to accept it.
[**Please make a $3 donation to make sure we have the resources to respond to Ted Budd and his super PAC allies’ constant attacks. Their lies go unanswered.**](https://act.cheribeasley.com/go/2567?c0=cb-em-oct22.I3buyh&refcode=em221007-3-MA&t=2&akid=1970%2E357359%2ExZ8lkA)

| | MELANIE STANDIFORD APPOINTED TO CHAIR POSITION OF FRONTIER COUNTY GOP
---
| | Melanie Standiford, of Curtis, Nebraska, is appointed to the vacant County Chair position of the Frontier County GOP. The request was made by Calvin Pemberton, Sub-District 305 Chair Representative. Pemberton requested Standiford be immediately appointed to fill the position temporarily until a formal election process could take place per Article XI Section 9 of the Frontier County GOP Constitution. NEGOP Chairman Eric Underwood said, “Frontier County is in good hands with Melanie stepping into the County Chair position.” Melanie has an extensive background in journalism, as well as a Bachelor of Science degree in Organizational Leadership and a Master’s degree in International Security and Intelligence Studies. Most recently, she distinguished herself as the News Director, producer, and co-anchor at KNOP-TV NBC Nebraska News 2; a position she held until she was fired last week by parent company Gray Television over her role in creating a “sanctuary city for the unborn” in her hometown of Curtis. The Nebraska Republican Party not only welcomes her as a leader but stands with Standiford’s strongly held belief of protecting the most innocent lives, the unborn. Underwood added, “Melanie is a representation of what is needed as a County Chair and the courage it takes to stand for the values we hold as Republicans.” ###

**MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike’s father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father’s arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman’s General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

This race is too important to sit on the sidelines and let my opponent claim he’s leading. Please, I need to hear from you and 50 of my other top supporters in order to keep our momentum strong and win this race. For America, Mike Lee MEET MIKE: | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike’s father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father’s arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property. After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman’s General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court. Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. | **WHAT AMENDMENTS ARE ON THE NOVEMBER 2022 GENERAL ELECTION BALLOT?**
In addition to state and local candidate choices, Missourians will have several proposed amendments to vote on when they head to the ballots for the November 8, 2022 General Election. Below is a detailed summary of each amendment Missourians will be tasked with approving or opposing: _**Amendment 1**_
**Should the Missouri Constitution be amended to allow the state treasurer to invest state funds in highly rated municipal securities and to authorize the state legislature to pass laws allowing the treasurer to invest in “other reasonable and prudent financial instruments and securities?”**

A **“YES”** vote _supports_ this constitutional amendment to allow the state treasurer to invest state funds in highly rated municipal securities and authorizes the state legislature to pass laws allowing the treasurer to invest in “other prudent financial instruments and securities”.

A **“NO”** vote _opposes_ this constitutional amendment, thus continuing to prohibit the state treasurer from investing state funds in municipal securities.

Amendment 1 would amend the Missouri Constitution to authorize the state treasurer to invest state funds in highly rated municipal securities. Specifically, the state treasurer would be allowed to invest in municipal securities that possess one of the five highest long term-ratings or short-term ratings issued by a nationally recognized rating agency. The ballot measure would also allow the legislature to pass laws allowing the treasurer to invest in "other reasonable and prudent financial instruments and securities."
Municipal securities are bonds to raise money for city roads, schools, or other projects deemed a public good. Currently, the state treasurer can invest in federal and agency bonds, time deposits in Missouri banks, repurchase agreements, or short-term unsecured corporate debt.
**_Amendment 3_**
**Should Missouri legalize the purchase, possession, consumption, use, delivery, manufacturing, and sale of recreational marijuana?**

A **“YES** ” vote _supports_ the legalization of recreational marijuana.

A **“NO”** vote _opposes_ the legalization of recreational marijuana, thus continuing to prohibit recreational use under current law.
The initiative would legalize the purchase, possession, consumption, use, delivery, manufacturing, and sale of marijuana for personal use for persons who are 21 years old or older; allow individuals convicted of non-violent marijuana-related offenses to petition to be released from incarceration and/or have their records expunged; and impose a 6% tax on the sale of marijuana. Commercial licenses would be limited and divided among Missouri’s congressional districts. **_Amendment 4_**
**Should a city whose police force established by a state board of police commissioners be required to increase its police force’s funding without state reimbursement?**

A **“YES** ” vote _supports_ allowing the legislature to increase minimum funding for a police force established by a state board of police commissioners.

A **“NO”** vote _opposes_ allowing the legislature to increase minimum funding for a police force established by a state board of police commissioners.

This amendment allows the legislature to pass a law until December 31, 2026, that requires a city to increase funding without reimbursement from the state to a police force that was established by a state board of police commissioners. _This amendment specifically includes the Kansas City Police Department because it_ _is the only police department in the state of Missouri that is governed by a state board of commissioners._ **_Amendment 5_**
**Should Missouri create the _Missouri Department of the National Guard_ within the state’s Executive Branch?**

A **“YES”** vote _supports_ creating the Missouri Department of the National Guard within the state’s Executive Branch.

A **“NO”** vote _opposes_ creating the Missouri Department of the National Guard, thus keeping the Missouri National Guard under the Missouri Department of Public Safety.

Amendment 5 would create the Missouri Department of the National Guard as an administrative department within the state's executive branch. As of 2022, the Missouri National Guard is part of the Missouri Department of Public Safety. As an executive department, the adjutant general, who commands the National Guard, would be a member of the governor's cabinet.
Amendment 5 would define the department's purpose as providing for the state militia, upholding the U.S. Constitution, upholding the Missouri Constitution, protecting the constitutional rights and civil liberties of Missourians, and providing other defenses as required.

According to the Missouri National Guard, allowing the Guard to become its own department would provide a direct line of communication between the Adjutant General to the Governor, and that “direct communication would ensure the Governor receives critical military advice and recommendations quickly in times of national or state crisis.”
**_Constitutional Convention_**
**Should Missouri change the state constitution by calling a constitutional convention?**

A **“YES”** vote supports a constitutional convention, thus allowing elected delegates to propose constitutional, including a rewritten constitution that must be approved by voters.

A **“NO”** vote opposes a constitutional convention, thus keeping the current state constitution as written.

In Missouri, a state [constitutional convention question](https://robertsforstl.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6e3f7ee3b541518ea63c7e773&id=cbd1ad478f&e=a088917f89 "Constitutional convention question") is provided to voters every 20 years after the prior question. Missourians addressed [a constitutional convention question](https://robertsforstl.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6e3f7ee3b541518ea63c7e773&id=893ea9541b&e=a088917f89 "Missouri Constitutional Convention \(2002\)") in 2002. Voters rejected the question by a margin of 65.45% to 34.55%.
A [constitutional convention](https://robertsforstl.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6e3f7ee3b541518ea63c7e773&id=a902045081&e=a088917f89 "State constitutional conventions") consists of elected delegates that propose changes to the state's constitution. Any proposed changes, including a rewritten constitution, must be approved by voters.

| **GOVERNOR SIGNS $2 BILLION TAX CUT, AGRICULTURE SUBSIDIES INTO LAW**
Gov. Mike Parson on Oct. 4 signed into law one bill enacting a $2 billion state income tax cut primarily benefitting the wealthy and another providing $40 million a year in special tax subsidies for agricultural producers.

The governor’s action came one day after the Republican-controlled General Assembly wrapped up the special legislative session Parson called in an attempt to shift voters’ attention to tax cuts ahead of the upcoming elections and mitigate the backlash from a highly unpopular GOP-backed law that took effect this summer prohibiting nearly all abortions in Missouri, including in cases resulting from rape or incest.

By a vote of 26-3, the Senate granted final passage to the agricultural tax subsidy measure, House Bill 3, on Oct. 3, ending a week-long stalemate with the House of Representatives over which chamber’s version of the bill go to the governor. HB 3 replaces similar legislation passed in the spring that Parson vetoed because the programs would have expired after just two years. The 10 separate subsidies in the revised bill are set to expire in six years unless renewed.

Lawmakers passed the tax bill a week earlier. While Parson, a Republican, wanted to cut the primary individual income tax rate from the current 5.3 percent to 4.8 percent, GOP legislators made an even deeper reduction to 4.5 percent, phased in over several years. The savings for middle-income taxpayers will be minimal, with a third of Missourians getting nothing.

Although the state currently has an unprecedented revenue surplus, largely due to an influx of federal pandemic relief funds, the situation is temporary. As a result, the loss of $2 billion a year in income tax revenue once the cuts are fully implemented is expected to sharply impair state government’s ability to adequately fund basic services. And because of a 1996 constitutional amendment, large tax cuts aren’t easily undone, with voter approval required to so.

| **HELP FOR SMALL BUSINESS AND NON- PROFITS **
The U.S. Small Business Administration approved Missouri’s request for assistance through the federal agency’s disaster loan program. This move makes low-interest disaster loans available to small businesses and private non-profits severely impacted by the Coronavirus (COVID-19).

SBA’s Economic Injury Disaster Loans offer up to $2 million in assistance for each affected small business or non-profit. These loans can provide vital economic support to small businesses to help overcome the temporary loss of revenue they are experiencing.

Applicants will be able to apply online, receive additional disaster assistance information and [download applications](https://robertsforstl.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6e3f7ee3b541518ea63c7e773&id=59957757e1&e=a088917f89). Capitol Ave., Rm 329 Jefferson City, MO 65101 (573) 751-4415 Steve.Roberts@senate.mo.gov | | | | | | | | | | | | WHAT AMENDMENTS ARE ON THE NOVEMBER 2022 GENERAL ELECTION BALLOT? In addition to state and local candidate choices, Missourians will have several proposed amendments to vote on when they head to the ballots for the November 8, 2022 General Election. Below is a detailed summary of each amendment Missourians will be tasked with approving or opposing: Amendment 1 Should the Missouri Constitution be amended to allow the state treasurer to invest state funds in highly rated municipal securities and to authorize the state legislature to pass laws allowing the treasurer to invest in “other reasonable and prudent financial instruments and securities?” A “YES” vote supports this constitutional amendment to allow the state treasurer to invest state funds in highly rated municipal securities and authorizes the state legislature to pass laws allowing the treasurer to invest in “other prudent financial instruments and securities”. A “NO” vote opposes this constitutional amendment, thus continuing to prohibit the state treasurer from investing state funds in municipal securities. Amendment 1 would amend the Missouri Constitution to authorize the state treasurer to invest state funds in highly rated municipal securities. Specifically, the state treasurer would be allowed to invest in municipal securities that possess one of the five highest long term-ratings or short-term ratings issued by a nationally recognized rating agency. The ballot measure would also allow the legislature to pass laws allowing the treasurer to invest in "other reasonable and prudent financial instruments and securities." Municipal securities are bonds to raise money for city roads, schools, or other projects deemed a public good. Currently, the state treasurer can invest in federal and agency bonds, time deposits in Missouri banks, repurchase agreements, or short-term unsecured corporate debt. Amendment 3 Should Missouri legalize the purchase, possession, consumption, use, delivery, manufacturing, and sale of recreational marijuana? A “YES ” vote supports the legalization of recreational marijuana. A “NO” vote opposes the legalization of recreational marijuana, thus continuing to prohibit recreational use under current law. The initiative would legalize the purchase, possession, consumption, use, delivery, manufacturing, and sale of marijuana for personal use for persons who are 21 years old or older; allow individuals convicted of non-violent marijuana-related offenses to petition to be released from incarceration and/or have their records expunged; and impose a 6% tax on the sale of marijuana. Commercial licenses would be limited and divided among Missouri’s congressional districts. Amendment 4 Should a city whose police force established by a state board of police commissioners be required to increase its police force’s funding without state reimbursement? A “YES ” vote supports allowing the legislature to increase minimum funding for a police force established by a state board of police commissioners. A “NO” vote opposes allowing the legislature to increase minimum funding for a police force established by a state board of police commissioners. This amendment allows the legislature to pass a law until December 31, 2026, that requires a city to increase funding without reimbursement from the state to a police force that was established by a state board of police commissioners. This amendment specifically includes the Kansas City Police Department because it is the only police department in the state of Missouri that is governed by a state board of commissioners. Amendment 5 Should Missouri create the Missouri Department of the National Guard within the state’s Executive Branch? A “YES” vote supports creating the Missouri Department of the National Guard within the state’s Executive Branch. A “NO” vote opposes creating the Missouri Department of the National Guard, thus keeping the Missouri National Guard under the Missouri Department of Public Safety. Amendment 5 would create the Missouri Department of the National Guard as an administrative department within the state's executive branch. As of 2022, the Missouri National Guard is part of the Missouri Department of Public Safety. As an executive department, the adjutant general, who commands the National Guard, would be a member of the governor's cabinet. Amendment 5 would define the department's purpose as providing for the state militia, upholding the U.S. Constitution, upholding the Missouri Constitution, protecting the constitutional rights and civil liberties of Missourians, and providing other defenses as required. According to the Missouri National Guard, allowing the Guard to become its own department would provide a direct line of communication between the Adjutant General to the Governor, and that “direct communication would ensure the Governor receives critical military advice and recommendations quickly in times of national or state crisis.” Constitutional Convention Should Missouri change the state constitution by calling a constitutional convention? A “YES” vote supports a constitutional convention, thus allowing elected delegates to propose constitutional, including a rewritten constitution that must be approved by voters. A “NO” vote opposes a constitutional convention, thus keeping the current state constitution as written. In Missouri, a state "Constitutional convention question" is provided to voters every 20 years after the prior question. Missourians addressed "Missouri Constitutional Convention \(2002\") in 2002. Voters rejected the question by a margin of 65.45% to 34.55%. A "State constitutional conventions" consists of elected delegates that propose changes to the state's constitution. Any proposed changes, including a rewritten constitution, must be approved by voters. | | | | GOVERNOR SIGNS $2 BILLION TAX CUT, AGRICULTURE SUBSIDIES INTO LAW Gov. Mike Parson on Oct. 4 signed into law one bill enacting a $2 billion state income tax cut primarily benefitting the wealthy and another providing $40 million a year in special tax subsidies for agricultural producers. The governor’s action came one day after the Republican-controlled General Assembly wrapped up the special legislative session Parson called in an attempt to shift voters’ attention to tax cuts ahead of the upcoming elections and mitigate the backlash from a highly unpopular GOP-backed law that took effect this summer prohibiting nearly all abortions in Missouri, including in cases resulting from rape or incest. By a vote of 26-3, the Senate granted final passage to the agricultural tax subsidy measure, House Bill 3, on Oct. 3, ending a week-long stalemate with the House of Representatives over which chamber’s version of the bill go to the governor. HB 3 replaces similar legislation passed in the spring that Parson vetoed because the programs would have expired after just two years. The 10 separate subsidies in the revised bill are set to expire in six years unless renewed. Lawmakers passed the tax bill a week earlier. While Parson, a Republican, wanted to cut the primary individual income tax rate from the current 5.3 percent to 4.8 percent, GOP legislators made an even deeper reduction to 4.5 percent, phased in over several years. The savings for middle-income taxpayers will be minimal, with a third of Missourians getting nothing. Although the state currently has an unprecedented revenue surplus, largely due to an influx of federal pandemic relief funds, the situation is temporary. As a result, the loss of $2 billion a year in income tax revenue once the cuts are fully implemented is expected to sharply impair state government’s ability to adequately fund basic services. | | | Peter, my name is Adam Laxalt. You may have never heard of me, so I wanted to take a moment to tell you a bit about why I'm running for U.S. Senate in Nevada.

I was born in Reno, Nevada and raised by a single mother. Growing up, it was just me and my mom. I have always aspired to be as much of a leader as she was.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61546759:JniCaFVYN:m:1:3331421248:1E1CF96A76F59C16224B0E51FB1E7CAD:r "Adam 1")
---

I know that real leadership means standing up for what you believe in and standing up for people everywhere. But I was headed down the wrong path in life.

As a teenager, I suffered from addiction. But the people who loved me got me help. I turned my life around, and that taught me helping others gives life meaning. That's why I volunteered to serve in the Navy after 9/11 and volunteered to serve in the Iraq War.

---
| | | [SUPPORT ADAM LAXALT](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61546759:JniCaFVYN:m:1:3331421248:1E1CF96A76F59C16224B0E51FB1E7CAD:r "SUPPORT ADAM LAXALT")
---

Serving our country as a Navy Officer in Iraq was an honor.

While I was serving, my unit was in charge of over 20,000 detainees to keep American troops safe. This was one of the most challenging experiences of my life, but also the most rewarding.

_Knowing that I was on the front lines of protecting the country I love so dearly is something that I will continue to cherish for the rest of my life. _

After returning from Iraq, I felt the call to serve my state again and went on to be Nevada's Attorney General and top law enforcement officer. I fought hard to serve the people of Nevada, where I fought against President Obama by suing over federal overreach. I fought for the Constitution.

Now I'm taking on a huge challenge for our country: running for U.S. Senate.

subject: Thomas and Kavanaugh 2.0
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY TEAM HERSCHEL, INC
body:
|
---
Peter,

When I decided to run for office, I knew I would be attacked. Unfortunately, that's politics these days.

I knew the Left would try to paint me as a man unfit to serve in public office. After all, I struggled with mental health issues when my professional football career ended. But I sought treatment, got help, and then spent the next decade encouraging others to get help if they needed it. In fact, I even wrote a book about my journey, _Breaking Free: My Life with Dissociated Identity Disorder_ , with the goal of helping others.

This summer, Raphael Warnock and Chuck Schumer's Super PAC spent more than $50 million attacking my character, my family, and my mental health struggles.

**But their ads didn't work.** The personal attacks against me failed to move the needle, so Raphael Warnock and I are neck-and-neck in the polls in the Georgia Senate race.

In their desperation to find something to distract the voters from real issues and blunt our momentum, they came up with an "October Surprise" alleging that I paid for a woman to have an abortion.

**Let me be clear: I have never paid for anyone to have an abortion. It's a flat-out lie.**

We cannot let the Left win by lying, cheating, or buying their way to victory. We need to stand together to fight back with the truth.

**[Peter, today I need your assistance more than ever before in this campaign. I need the resources to talk directly to the voters and clear the record.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61546656:J_jVaFVpN:m:1:3253819041:A576754A617DA5BD8AED1F710EF5E40A:r) **

Undecided voters are watching this race closely, and the Left knows it. That's why, 30 days before the election, they decided to distract from the real issues by telling a lie about me.

First, the Left used these tactics against Justice Clarence Thomas in an unsuccessful effort to keep him off the Supreme Court.

Then, 27 years later, they did the same thing to Justice Brett Kavanaugh as they tried to destroy him, his reputation, and his family.

Their intimidation tactics didn't work on Justices Thomas or Kavanaugh, and they're not going to work on me. Right now, all they've done is energize me more.

**The Left is desperate to win this Senate race because they want to change this country, but we're not going to let it happen.**

**[I need your help and support now more than ever. Will you please stand with me?](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61546656:J_jVaFVpN:m:1:3253819041:A576754A617DA5BD8AED1F710EF5E40A:r)**

Thanks,

clean_body: | Peter, When I decided to run for office, I knew I would be attacked. Unfortunately, that's politics these days. I knew the Left would try to paint me as a man unfit to serve in public office. After all, I struggled with mental health issues when my professional football career ended. But I sought treatment, got help, and then spent the next decade encouraging others to get help if they needed it. In fact, I even wrote a book about my journey, Breaking Free: My Life with Dissociated Identity Disorder , with the goal of helping others. This summer, Raphael Warnock and Chuck Schumer's Super PAC spent more than $50 million attacking my character, my family, and my mental health struggles. But their ads didn't work. The personal attacks against me failed to move the needle, so Raphael Warnock and I are neck-and-neck in the polls in the Georgia Senate race. In their desperation to find something to distract the voters from real issues and blunt our momentum, they came up with an "October Surprise" alleging that I paid for a woman to have an abortion. Let me be clear: I have never paid for anyone to have an abortion. It's a flat-out lie. We cannot let the Left win by lying, cheating, or buying their way to victory. We need to stand together to fight back with the truth. Undecided voters are watching this race closely, and the Left knows it. That's why, 30 days before the election, they decided to distract from the real issues by telling a lie about me. First, the Left used these tactics against Justice Clarence Thomas in an unsuccessful effort to keep him off the Supreme Court. Then, 27 years later, they did the same thing to Justice Brett Kavanaugh as they tried to destroy him, his reputation, and his family. Their intimidation tactics didn't work on Justices Thomas or Kavanaugh, and they're not going to work on me. Right now, all they've done is energize me more. Friends, As you know, Democrats continue to fawn all of radical Stacey Abrams. She's featured on the cover of every major magazine...is the "go-to" politician on the talk show circuit...and has earned every accolade and compliment from Hollywood. While admirers call her the "Savior of Democracy," can we just call Stacey Abrams what she really is? **A loser.** Yep. She ran and lost in 2018. Abrams wanted to be picked for Vice President and lost that too. And most recently, Abrams' claims against the state of Georgia's voting laws - that cost Peach State taxpayers about $6 million to defend - were rejected by an Obama-appointed Judge. ["A federal judge has finally exposed Ms. Abrams’s claims of voter suppression for what they are—false. Georgians can take heart that the rule of law has prevailed again, the truth has won out, and these baseless attacks on our state and its elections can finally be put to bed."](https://sable.madmimi.com/c/434664?id=1706147.497.1.776925bb492917c0edd268c0ae4fa92b) Despite her penchant for losing, Stacey Abrams' celebrity and allure are still sky high. The Left will use cancel-culture tactics to pressure other companies to cut business ties. Government contracts will only go to the “right” companies with the “right” ESG scores. The Left will deplatform companies from needed services—like banking, advertising, and internet services. **Who does ESG hurt?** Everyone! Customers, employees, small businesses, big businesses, investors, and anyone with a retirement account will suffer under an ESG regime. We’ve seen what socialist control of businesses looks like in China, Venezuela, the USSR—it’s not good! **What kind of companies would be punished under ESG?** American oil and gas companies. Companies that don’t pledge to go 100% green. Companies that fail to mandate CRT trainings for employees. Companies that don’t push “woke” gender ideology. The list goes on and on...And it's a BIG DEAL! Once you cross the Left, they will use ESG to target you. [_**As I wrote**_](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zesh84q72bmbokp8s4qbp3nkgguc6br45jc06sqg_rp22sh2s8i66or5c9h6coj1cdh2bs) in my op-ed, **Elon Musk found this out the hard way.** After his public stance on free speech and efforts to purchase Twitter, his “electric cars, solar, and clean energy” company was excluded from the ESG index. ESG is infecting every level of government and finance: last May, Biden’s pick to lead banking regulation said “the way we basically get rid of those carbon financiers is we starve them of their sources of capital." This is the heart of ESG — financially starving any companies who aren't in line with the progressive ideology. We've already watched as this administration has shuttered pipelines, denied permits, and cut off development-bank financing for oil and gas — all in line with the so-called ESG agenda. At Heritage Action, we're working to fight back and prevent the spread of ESG rules and regulations. Through education, activism, and legislation, we can fight ESG, just like we did CRT (Critical Race Theory). But we need your support to raise awareness and STOP ESG! **Will you join us by signing the petition to END ESG now?[_https://heritageaction.com/support/_](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z2ipr1ka1l8rm8cr7faom847m48kefj8e3m55i2g_rp22sh2s8i66or5c9h6coj1cdh2bs)** _ESG policies are nothing but a thinly veiled attempt to radically transform corporations into social justice warriors and exclude conservatives from competing in our economy._ We cannot allow this to continue.Make your voice heard by signing your name now.

| | | Hi, friend, it's Tiffany Smiley.

I wanted to take the time today to personally reach out and say _**thank you**_ for your generous contribution to my campaign for U.S. Senate.

I can't even begin to express my gratitude for your support.

Because of your help, I am closing in on my Democrat opponent Patty Murray _more_ and _more_ each day. The latest poll has me only 2 points behind!

_**We are doing something no one thought was possible in Washington state.**_ For decades, no Republican candidate has come _this close_ to taking down a Democrat incumbent.

This is truly a historic race, and I'm so glad to have you on the team!

By now you may have heard my story and why I'm taking the risk to run for United States Senate.

As a mom of three, _all_ I think about is my children's future.

With Joe Biden and Patty Murray in charge, the American Dream for future generations is at risk.

**That 's my call to action. I simply refuse to sit idly by and accept this fate for my sons. **

With just a few weeks left until the General Election, I'm asking for your support _**just one more time. **_

_**[We're so close to the finish line, I just need your help this last time to get me past it.](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zsmfadokpum4bgqsl3jo28e6ni7rna5b9pl1u7a0_rp22sh2s8i66or5c9h6coj6c3h2bs "We’re so close to the finish line, I just need your help this last time to get me past it.")**_

I hate to ask again because you've already shown me so much support, but I'd appreciate anything you can give today!

---

Tiffany Smiley

---

The entire nation is watching and waiting to see if Tiffany can take down a 30-year career politician to bring real change to the Pacific Northwest.

With the polls nearly _neck and neck,_ there's no time left to waste. We need grassroots supporters from every corner of the country to help boost Tiffany's momentum heading into November.

The time is NOW to change the trajectory of our country. Supporting Tiffany is supporting the future of our nation.
_**[Be a part of history by chipping in to support Tiffany today!](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2z3kreccou0ajd8mhof3vsmb3j2d8jdtto0n5i2jo_rp22sh2s8i66or5c9h6coj6c3h2bs "Be a part of history by chipping in to support Tiffany today!")**_

---

Team Smiley here with a RED ALERT!

You know we don't often beg, plead, or panic, but Tiffany is facing a key deadline, and we're OUT of time.

Whether or not you choose to act will decide the outcome of the Washington U.S. Senate Election:

Tiffany is currently being outraised and outspent by her 30-year incumbent opponent. We need all hands on deck to turn things around TODAY.

There's no time to wait on the sidelines.

_**[That's why we're HUMBLY asking for your help in the next 15 minutes!](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zg5blcc9taedali836qpvaphv41lcqr4t5aoq00o_rp22sh2s8i66or5c9h6coj6c3h2bs "That's why we're HUMBLY asking for your help in the next 15 minutes!")**_

This is our only chance to make history and restore a brighter future for Washington and all of America. We need Tiffany Smiley in the U.S. Senate, plain and simple.

Our team doesn't want to have to deliver bad news to Tiffany later today, so we're calling on our grassroots team, including YOU, to help increase our momentum!

Tiffany is a veterans' advocate and mother of 3! She is the new, fresh leadership we desperately need in Washington! Tiffany will be your #1 supporter in the U.S. Senate.

We're out of time. There's nowhere else to turn. Tiffany needs us at this moment. _**[Step up now!](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2z5tartc45649qbhgv1ph0u7peiegoptcivdu1tc0_rp22sh2s8i66or5c9h6coj6c3h2bs "Step up now!")**_

body:
| |
---
| | | Peter,

My name is Tiffany Smiley and I wanted to tell you a little bit about myself and why I'm running for the U.S. Senate in Washington.

I grew up in Pasco, Washington where I helped out on my family's farm and learned the value of hard work.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61548842:69RDXFVNU:m:1:3331421248:FEB86CB6EFB6B0692784CCC6BD468D85:r "I helped out on my family’s farm and learned the value of
hard work.")
---

I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College, where I also studied to become a nurse so I could pursue my passion of helping others in need.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61548842:69RDXFVNU:m:1:3331421248:FEB86CB6EFB6B0692784CCC6BD468D85:r "I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College")
---

I married my high school sweetheart Scotty, who went on to serve our country in the United States Army while I started my nursing career.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61548842:69RDXFVNU:m:1:3331421248:FEB86CB6EFB6B0692784CCC6BD468D85:r "I married my high school sweetheart Scotty")
---

In 2005, I received a call that changed both our lives forever, Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq, causing him to fall into a coma and permanently lose sight in both of his eyes.

I immediately booked a flight for Walter Reed Medical Center to be by Scotty's side.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61548842:69RDXFVNU:m:1:3331421248:FEB86CB6EFB6B0692784CCC6BD468D85:r "Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq")

and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.")

body:
Biden Admin Propaganda Exposed!

[INSIDE JW]

Judicial Watch Sues for Details of Ashli Babbitt’s Shooter’s
Special Housing

[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60546&L=28232&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly95b3V0dS5iZS9sNUVEa2xlY1p5RT91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycyZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1DTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0Q=]

The government’s actions during and after the January 6, 2021,
events at the U.S. Capitol continue raising serious questions. We’re
now pursuing a rather extraordinary cover-up of Defense Department
involvement in the aftermath of the police killing of an unarmed
veteran on that day.

We filed a Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) lawsuit against the U.S.
Department of Defense and U.S. Department of Justice for records
related to the housing of U.S. Capitol Police Lieutenant Michael Byrd
at Joint Base Andrews after he shot and killed U.S. Air Force veteran
Ashli Babbitt inside the U.S. Capitol on January 6, 2021 (_Judicial
Watch v U.S. Department of Defense and U.S. Department of Justice_
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60546&L=28231&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXYtZG9kLWJ5cmQtYmFiYml0dC1jb21wbGFpbnQtMDI5NDgvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJzJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUNNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRA==]
(No. 1:22-cv-02948)).

We have received information that Byrd was housed at Andrews in the
immediate period after he killed Babbitt.

The unarmed Babbitt was shot and killed
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60546&L=24980&F=T&]
as she allegedly climbed through a broken interior window in the
United States Capitol. She was a 14-year Air Force veteran. The
identity of the shooter was kept secret by Congress, the Justice
Department, and DC police for eight months until Byrd went public
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60546&L=25838&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly9ueXBvc3QuY29tLzIwMjEvMDgvMjYvY2FwaXRvbC1vZmZpY2VyLW1pY2hhZWwtYnlyZC1zcGVha3MtYWJvdXQtc2hvb3RpbmctYXNobGktYmFiYml0dC8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnMmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Q01qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNE]
in August 2021 to try to defend his killing of Babbitt.

We sued in the U.S. District Court for the District of Columbia after
Joint Base Andrews, the Civil Rights Division of the Justice
Department, and the FBI failed to respond to three July 2022 FOIA
requests about Byrd’s housing while his name as the shooter of Ashli
Babbitt was being withheld from the public by the government.

In our complaint, we explained to the court that we had asked all
three government agencies for all records relating to the billeting of
Byrd at Andrews from January 6, 2021, to July 2022, including
authorization papers, housing, meals, transportation, and visitor
logs.

Here’s some background.

In June 2022, we produced DOJ records
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60546&L=27468&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9qLW1lbW8tZGVjbGluaW5nLWNyaW1pbmFsLXByb3NlY3V0aW9uLWZvci1hc2hsaS1iYWJiaXR0cy1zaG9vdGVyLz91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycyZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1DTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0Q=]
related to the shooting that included a memo recommending “that the
United States Attorney’s Office for the District of Columbia decline
for criminal prosecution the fatal shooting of Ashli McEntee
[Babbitt],” also noting that the shooter, Byrd, “did not create a
police report or documents” related to the shooting of Babbitt. A
footnote details missing evidence: “During the debrief of Lieutenant
Byrd, he did recall writing a few sentences on an evidence bag the
evening of January 6, 2021, at the request of a crime scene officer.
To date, the bag has not been located by USCP or MPD.”

In November 2021, we received
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60546&L=26726&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvanctZGMtcG9saWNlLWJhYmJpdHQvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJzJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUNNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRA==]
multiple audio
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60546&L=26288&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvanctdi1kYy1hc2hsaS1iYWJiaXR0LW5vdmVtYmVyLTIwMjEtYXVkaW8tMDAxNzEwLz91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycyZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1DTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0Q=],
visual
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60546&L=26727&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL3RhZ3MvYmFiYml0dC1qYW4tNi1pbWFnZXMtMDAxNzEwLWIvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJzJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUNNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRA==]
and photo records
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60546&L=26727&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL3RhZ3MvYmFiYml0dC1qYW4tNi1pbWFnZXMtMDAxNzEwLWIvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJzJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUNNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRA==]
from the DC Metropolitan Police Department about the shooting death of
Ashli Babbitt on January 6, 2021, in the U.S. Capitol Building. The
records include a cell phone video
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60546&L=26288&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvanctdi1kYy1hc2hsaS1iYWJiaXR0LW5vdmVtYmVyLTIwMjEtYXVkaW8tMDAxNzEwLz91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycyZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1DTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0Q=]
of the shooting. An audio file of a police interview of the shooter,
Byrd, indicates he declined to cooperate.

We previously uncovered records from the DC Metropolitan Police
showing that multiple officers claimed they didn’t see a weapon
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60546&L=26290&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvanctYmFiYml0dC1uZXctaW5mby8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnMmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Q01qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNE]
in Babbitt’s
hand before Byrd shot her, and that Byrd was visibly distraught
afterward. One officer attested that he didn’t recall hearing any
verbal commands before Byrd shot Babbitt. The records include internal
communications about Byrd’s case and a crime scene examination
report. Investigators who wrote the January 6, 2021, Metro PD Death
Report
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60546&L=26043&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXYtZGMtYmFiYml0dC1vY3RvYmVyLTIwMjEtMDAxNzEwLXBncy0zLTQvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJzJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUNNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRA==]
for Babbitt (identified as Ashli Elizabeth McEntee-Babbitt Pamatian)
note that the possible Manner of Death was “Homicide (Police
Involved Shooting).”

We are engaged in a comprehensive, independent investigation into the
January 6 disturbance:

* February 2022: we filed an opposition
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60546&L=26729&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvcGVsb3NpLWNvbmdyZXNzLWNsYWltcy1pbW11bml0eS1pbi1jb3VydC8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnMmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Q01qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNE]
to the U.S. Capitol Police’s (USCP) effort to shut down our federal
lawsuit for January 6 videos and emails. Through its police
department, Congress argues
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60546&L=26725&F=T&]
that the videos and emails are not public records, there is no public
interest in their release, and that “sovereign immunity” prevents
citizens from suing for their release.
* In November 2021: we – in our FOIA lawsuit asking for records of
communication between the Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) and

[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60546&L=26728&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZmJpLWxhdy0xLTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJzJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUNNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRA==]

The agency created after 9/11 to protect the nation from another
terrorist attack is giving nonprofits, local governments, and academic
institutions millions of dollars to promote media literacy and combat
what the Biden administration considers to be “disinformation.”
Among the recipients of the grants awarded by the Department of
Homeland Security (DHS) is a center founded by former President Jimmy
Carter to implement a “media literacy curriculum” designed to
mitigate the harms presented by disinformation. In all, DHS will dole
out around $7 million for its new media literacy campaign, which is
part of a broader and handsomely funded initiative called Targeted
Violence and Terrorism Prevention Program (TVTP) launched in 2020 to
“prevent targeted violence and terrorism.”

This year DHS is doling out $20 million
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60546&L=28233&F=T&]
in grants to dozens of recipients to meet TVTP’s mission of
preventing incidents of domestic violent extremism, as well as to
bolster efforts to counter online radicalization and mobilization to
violence. In the press release announcing the $20 million investment,
DHS Secretary Alejandro Mayorkas said the agency is equipping local
communities and organizations, including those “historically
underserved,” with needed resources to become more effective
partners to strengthen security and help Americans feel safe and
secure. In the announcement DHS reveals that it encouraged applicants
from diverse groups and conducted extensive outreach to a variety of
public and nonprofit sectors. In fact, the agency writes that among
this year’s priorities is “advancing equity in awards and engaging
underserved communities in prevention.”

A chunk of the TVTP money—$7 million—will be dedicated to the
media literacy campaign
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60546&L=28234&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuZGhzLmdvdi90dnRwZ3JhbnRzP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJzJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUNNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRA==],
which will
focus largely on combatting “misinformation and disinformation.”

president, is getting $99,372 to implement its media literacy
curriculum. The goal is to address the gap in media literacy education
in the United States within a targeted violence and terrorism
prevention context to demonstrate the effectiveness in mitigating the
harms presented by disinformation, according to DHS. “This
partnership would allow The Carter Center to deploy its curriculum
modules over a two-year period in multiple classroom settings
targeting a wide population aged 18 to 60 years old,” DHS writes in
its recent announcement. “Media literacy trainings build capacities
in evaluating media sources, assessing media intent, interpreting
media messages, understanding how the brain processes information,
understanding how online media shapes perception, recognizing false
and misleading information, investigating suspicious claims, and
practicing good media hygiene.”

The University of Rhode Island will receive $701,612 to combat
disinformation, conspiracy theories and propaganda that have become
large-scale social problems shaping the ways citizens view facts,
define truth, and make decisions, according to DHS. The university
will use the taxpayer dollars to create initiatives that help people
critically analyze information, digital media, and popular culture to
benefit all members of society by “diminishing the appeal of
us-vs-them thinking that activates strong emotions and oversimplifies
ideas and information.” The Woodrow Wilson International Center for
Scholars will get $750,000 to create an “educational digital game”
designed to help students understand different strategies used to
spread disinformation and combat it at the institutional level. The
Uran Rural Action, a group that strives for a “more inclusive
democracy” across ideological and racial differences, will receive
$769,190 to create a “Local Prevention Framework.”

Above is just a sample of the groups that will fill their coffers with
public funds for this fictitious crisis created by the Biden
administration to control information. Many more are getting six
figures from the government for this nonsense. “Disinformation,
conspiracy theories, and propaganda have become large-scale social
problems, shaping the way citizens view facts, define truth, and make
decisions,” according to the DHS grant document.

The university will use the taxpayer dollars to create initiatives that help people critically analyze information, digital media, and popular culture to benefit all members of society by “diminishing the appeal of us-vs-them thinking that activates strong emotions and oversimplifies ideas and information.” The Woodrow Wilson International Center for Scholars will get $750,000 to create an “educational digital game” designed to help students understand different strategies used to spread disinformation and combat it at the institutional level. The Uran Rural Action, a group that strives for a “more inclusive democracy” across ideological and racial differences, will receive $769,190 to create a “Local Prevention Framework.” Above is just a sample of the groups that will fill their coffers with public funds for this fictitious crisis created by the Biden administration to control information. Many more are getting six figures from the government for this nonsense. “Disinformation, conspiracy theories, and propaganda have become large-scale social problems, shaping the way citizens view facts, define truth, and make decisions,” according to the DHS grant document. Until next week... Well here’s something we never thought we’d see. **Fox “News” just DOWNGRADED Chuck Grassley chances of winning, saying he is “vulnerable after a recent Des Moines Register poll showed the longtime incumbent at 47%.”**

| | | Peter, you know I hate to be negative.

There's truly no one who believes in this campaign more than me, which is why it kills me to say I may have to __**[call it quits.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61549721:634mFFVTN:m:1:3253819041:FD1CA9C21E095C126301B93390BAF028:r "call it quits.")**__

My finance team just called me and delivered some devastating news... _**we 're about to come up $4,750 short of our goal.**_

---
| | [HELP MEET TIFFANY'S GOAL](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61549721:634mFFVTN:m:1:3253819041:FD1CA9C21E095C126301B93390BAF028:r "HELP MEET TIFFANY’S GOAL")
---

Why is this such devastating news, you ask? Well, my opponent, Patty Murray, hit her goal DAYS ago and is already launching huge ad campaigns.

I'm genuinely overwhelmed by all of this. I don't see how we can catch up to an ever-growing and seemingly unbeatable war chest.

_**And to make matters worse, other Republican candidates are suffering the same fate and are closing up shop.**_

This couldn't be more severe and is why I'm asking - no begging - you to read every word of this email.

I'm a first-time candidate, veteran advocate, and political outsider. I've spent so much of my life raising my 3 incredible boys and caring for my husband when he was permanently blinded while serving in Iraq.

Unlike my opponent, I haven't spent the last 30 years building connections and raising money from political elites.

But that's precisely why I have a real chance of defeating her this November. I'm bringing the fresh ideas and leadership America needs, and the Democrats know it.

So I'll get right to it.

I need you on my team. I won't put a number on it because I mean it when I say anything you give can and will be a game-changer in this election.

We're creeping into the final hour of today's deadline, but I know that we'll keep this campaign going with your support.

_**[So what do you think? Will you be a part of my history-making campaign by chipping in what you can before tonight's deadline?](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61549721:634mFFVTN:m:1:3253819041:FD1CA9C21E095C126301B93390BAF028:r "So what do you think? Will you be a part of my history-making campaign by chipping in what you can before
tonight’s deadline?")**_

I really hope you understand where I'm coming from.

I promise I wouldn't reach out like this if it weren't the end of the road.

Sincerely,

Tiffany Smiley

🚨

Since days before Hurricane Ian made landfall, Governor Ron DeSantis and First Lady Casey DeSantis have been laser-focused on the recovery efforts for communities affected by the hurricane. The Governor is working with local, state, and federal officials to provide direct relief to Floridians and support first responders working around the clock to help those in need.

On Wednesday, Governor DeSantis announced the early completion of the bridge to Pine Island restoring access for emergency personnel, utility trucks, and crews to begin working to make the island safe. The bridge was completed in just three days.

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=5ea7f58ae72f38c0b4898c92fc3a35888511d50deb972f0572413d3472aba0b6d3c54d6dddd68dfc1b99caa987f5ca27a37e258737c03ce8

“Within 24 hours after I asked FDOT [Florida Department of Transportation] to get involved, we had more than 130 trucks rolling in and crews got to work. We made it a priority and we didn’t just get it done — we got it done quick.” — Governor Ron DeSantis

A week after Hurricane Ian made landfall, nearly 2.6 million power outages have been restored. In a press conference, Governor DeSantis said he wanted to make Southwest Florida the linemen capital of the world – and he did.

See below for an incredible video of linemen heading into the Fort Myers area:

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=4f0a6250950e1ec2619d8343b395d0ae010a69814ba19937c09e8cbe1ffd7a25f61f6d29744192b354f83fb3481dacda336510681e9852bd

Governor DeSantis and the First Lady have been on the ground in Florida’s hardest-hit communities since before Hurricane Ian even made landfall in the state. They have been working to support Floridians and the tens of thousands of first responders that have sprung into action to help those in need.

“Waffle House is one of the first restaurants in Charlotte County to reopen and provide hot meals as we work together to serve Floridians after #HurricaneIan. Thank you for providing meals to the lineman working to restore power.” — Governor Ron DeSantis

"God Bless our Florida National Guardsmen and First Responders who are deploying resources to the residents on Pine Island. It was an honor to meet all of you – keep it up, we’re proud of you!” — First Lady Casey DeSantis

“Worked with Florida Baptist Relief to distribute food and water to residents of Naples. Casey DeSantis and I have been encouraged by the outpouring of prayers and assistance for Floridians in need. Keep up the good work!” — Governor Ron DeSantis

In response to Hurricane Ian, First Lady DeSantis launched the Florida Disaster Fund to help provide direct relief to Floridians hit hardest by the storm. Her effort received an overwhelming response from across the state and country and raised more than $40 million within the week of activation.

To contribute directly to Floridians in need, please text DISASTER to 20222.

On October 1st, Florida’s gas tax holiday went into effect, saving Floridians $200 million by lowering the price of gas by 25.3 cents per gallon. Florida now has the 5th lowest gas prices in the country.

Amid the distractions caused by lingering health issues, conflicts overseas, shortages, and inflation... Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen recently took the stage at COP26 in Glasgow, Scotland to address some of the world's most powerful people, including:
* U.S. President, Joe Biden...
* British Prime Minister, Boris Johnson...
* Canadian Prime Minister, Justin Trudeau...
* French President Emmanuel Macron...
* ... and many more...

From the stage, Yellen called for world leaders to commit to a $150 trillion 'global transition' of our economy. Since then, Bank of America has [signed this accord,](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zkjojl2obt0a6so046r2r64be1ko7jl1mbluku38_rp22sh2s8i66or5c9j64oj4sth2bs) along with 131 countries, 234 cities, and 695 of the world's biggest companies. Jeff Bezos and Elon Musk have invested in this 'transformation' as well. What is it that Yellen, Biden, Trudeau, Bezos and Musk are pushing for? And what does it mean for your money? Investigative journalist and renowned economist, Nomi Prins has followed the money... [And what she's found is startling. ](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zbn1p9hv9rpvhmedkrnda59k6mkmpp109pvrqde8_rp22sh2s8i66or5c9j64oj4sth2bs) She says: **" While most Americans are distracted by mainstream media headlines calling for a stock market crash, I've found evidence that shows where the elites are spending $150 trillion to 'transform' the economy. Most Americans will be shocked when they see what happens next."** I had to know more, so I scheduled an interview for Nomi to go deeper into the details of this 'transformation.' She agreed to do the interview on one condition: she wanted to record it so she could get her message in front of as many Americans as possible before it's too late. [Go here to see how this ‘transformation’ will play out – and what it means for your money.](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z1il14ul6rro0ocjen355d615mkc01lop9eosjq0_rp22sh2s8i66or5c9j64oj4sth2bs) Regards, Maria Bonaventura

subject: Chabot for Congress - Update from the Campaign Trail 10/7
body:
New Ad Alert, First Debate, and much more!
No images? [Click here](https://start.rightmailer.net/t/r-e-tjzijuy-kujkulhluu-n/) [](https://start.rightmailer.net/t/r-l-tjzijuy-kujkulhluu-r/)
# Update from the Campaign Trail 10/7/22
Good evening,Election Day is quickly approaching. Team Chabot continues to work hard to bring us across the finish line. This week, we have a new ad, a new op-ed on Greg Landsman's attempt to defund the police, some event updates, and a summary of the first debate between Congressman Chabot and Greg Landsman. Read on for these updates and more from the trail! **_Congressman Chabot on the Trail_** _Congressman Chabot Knocking Doors_ Congressman Chabot continues to work hard and speak to voters directly at their doors. This past weekend, Congressman Chabot knocked doors in Montgomery and other parts of Hamilton County. Team Chabot knocked doors throughout the rest of Ohio's First Congressional District. Responses have been very positive as our team continues to work throughout the district! _Local 12 Debate_ On Monday, Congressman Chabot participated in a debate with Greg Landsman hosted by Local 12, the AJC, and JCRC. The debate highlighted how out-of-touch Greg Landsman is with the concerns of people in our community and how he will be a rubber stamp for Nancy Pelosi's radical agenda. Before the debate, Congressman Chabot was greeted by a group of supporters who cheered him on throughout the debate. You can watch a replay of the debate on Local 12's website [here](https://start.rightmailer.net/t/r-l-tjzijuy-kujkulhluu-y/). _NEW AD ALERT - "Rising Costs"_Our latest ad, "Rising Costs" was released earlier today. The ad features an Ohio mom who highlights the stark contrast in the race for Ohio's First Congressional District.Voters have a clear choice between Congressman Chabot and his proven record of delivering results and fighting for lower costs or former Pelosi staffer Greg Landsman and his tax-hiking, inflation-fueling agenda that increases the burden on hardworking families and undermines our economy. Southwest Ohio families who deserve relief from out-of-control inflation and rising costs simply cannot afford Greg Landsman in Congress. [](https://start.rightmailer.net/t/r-l-tjzijuy-kujkulhluu-j/) _Owl's Nest Family Fun Day_ This past weekend, Congressman Chabot attended the Owl's Nest Family Fun Day in East Walnut Hills. It was a great event that even afforded the Congressman a few minutes to paint, a first on the campaign trail! **_East Hyde Park Fall Family Festival_** This past weekend, Congressman Chabot attended the East Hyde Park Fall Family Festival. The event was a perfect opportunity to spend some time with families in Hyde Park. **_Taiwanese Community Lunch_** Thank you to Lily Wong and Miao Cheng for organizing Saturday's wonderful lunch with members of the local Taiwanese community. You know me, Derek.

You know I'm laser-focused on fighting for Pennsylvania's working families, so emailing you to ask for money is the last thing I want to do.
But elections are expensive, and with _just one month to go_ , we need all the resources to reach each and every voter by knocking on doors, sending mailers, and running TV ads.

We know we have the winning message in PA-06. A message of progress. One of fighting for lower prices and more opportunities for workers. One of helping our businesses. And one of protecting our freedoms and our democracy. Now we need every voter to hear it.
**On the other hand, my opponent’s extremist allies have millions of dollars on hand to go all in on the Philly airwaves, and they'll do anything in their power to flip PA-06 red.**
We can't afford to go backward. We have the momentum; we just have to keep it going all the way to the finish line. You know I wouldn't be asking if it weren't important – but I need your help, Derek.

**With just one month until Election Day, can I count on you to be by my side? Will you please donate $5****– or whatever you can – so we can keep this seat and the House blue?**

You can donate online here: [**https://secure.actblue.com/donate/houlahan-digital**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52191586/371544051/685235109?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk708-fr-nd&recurring=0&&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NDkxMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4NGIwNDUyNy0wOTQ3LWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgyNThkMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=hS6Zz2nneLvQBppGGwnTmW_gsSapqYd6NirJNGb7tkk=)

name: Candace Owens
subject: Hollywood = Satanic Values
body:
[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61549995:6XNi4FVNX:m:1:3253819041:72EE42A777A6717A16AE0F3BAD79DED5:r)
Peter,

Would you believe me if I said that a mother watched videos of her daughter having sex with her boyfriend and picked which one her daughter looked best in to **sell?**

Because that's exactly what happened -- Kris Jenner watched AND hand-picked which sex tape her daughter Kim Kardashian would release!

**It is not an exaggeration to say that Hollywood is satanic.**
What could possibly be more satanic than a mother using her daughter's body to sell sex?

If that disgusts you, here's where it gets worse. _It worked_. Kim Kardashian is a billionaire, and she's still selling sex.

She is symbolic of the society we live in today. That if you are willing to degrade yourself, if you're willing to denigrate yourself, then our society will give you more.

**Is this the example we want to leave for our children?**

At BLEXIT, we believe families should be grounded in faith and honor and respect their children and protect their innocence.

My name is Candace Owens, co-founder of the BLEXIT Foundation. BLEXIT focuses on educating minorities about the history of our great country, the principles of the Constitution, and the importance of self-reliance.

I've set a goal to raise $50,000 by the end of the month to show the next generation that they don't have to be like the Kardashians to be successful.

[**Can you support this critical mission with a gift of $25, $35, or even $50? Click here to donate today >>>**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61549995:6XNi4FVNX:m:1:3253819041:72EE42A777A6717A16AE0F3BAD79DED5:r)

BLEXIT is bringing pro-America, pro-Family values to Black and minority communities through the work of our State Chapters.

Our Chapters spread the universal principles of the BLEXIT movement at the local level through community service, social engagement, educational activities, and virtual events.

They demonstrate how people can escape the mentality of victimhood and empower others to take control of their destinies.

Just this summer, **BLEXIT-Fest in New Jersey introduced our message to over 400 people.** They had a variety of talented performers and speakers and created a memorable community celebration.

**BLEXIT chapter members from our Tampa, FL, and North Charleston, SC sites educated and cared for approximately 80 children** for six weeks during our full-day Summer Camp.

The children in our Tampa program even took a field trip to Legoland!

Now that school has started, these BLEXIT chapters are providing an after-school youth education program - Liberation Camp - for 80 children.

_BLEXIT 's Chapters are a huge part of our Back to School initiative_.

The BLEXIT Illinois Chapter **distributed over 400 school supplies** and BLEXIT merchandise in one of Chicago's most impoverished communities. The NY Chapter was fortunate to **give away 120 school supply kits as well as 40 book bags.**

BLEXIT Chapters are changing the narrative that surrounds America's minority communities.

[**We currently have 42 chapters across the US and more than 14,000 volunteers! You can help BLEXIT support our State Chapters by donating $25, $35, $50, or any other amount today. Click here to send your gift >>>**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61549995:6XNi4FVNX:m:1:3253819041:72EE42A777A6717A16AE0F3BAD79DED5:r)

BLEXIT is the Black exit from the culture of victimhood, fear, and dependence reinforced by groups that market themselves as serving the Black community, such as Black Lives Matter, but in actuality, they destroy communities.

These organizations are poisoning minority communities. They tell these bright young men and women they are victims of systematic repression and that their skin color is all that defines them.

But here's the ugly truth about other organizations who claim to serve the Black community:

* They claim to support Black communities. . . but they fan the flames of riots and violence that directly impact the lives of the people in those communities.

* They claim to fight for criminal justice reform. . . but they teach Black men and women to hate and disrespect police officers.

* They claim to be a non-profit group fighting for Black men and women. . . but they use donor funds to enrich themselves.

**These other organizations are destroying Black communities, dividing our country, and forcing a message of victimhood and hatred down the throats of minorities.**

BLEXIT is countering their hateful narrative, but we can't do it alone, Peter. Can you donate to BLEXIT today and help us reach our goal of raising $50,000?
