#
_Tammy Baldwin is the U.S. Senator from Wisconsin and a fierce defender of working families. People know that Tammy will sit down with anyone, no matter their party, and she’ll take on anyone, no matter how powerful, if it means getting the job done for folks like you. We’re counting on your grassroots support in the work ahead, but if you’d prefer, you can[unsubscribe here.](https://secure.ngpvan.com/p/nLry_zhVNEeFldOnSc1DGQ2?unsubscribedata=R0Sa8jSNIjmah9YVoWgxhdPAl6hQGD%2BDHHcvAW6nCcBbQV2M%2BQE5VxCFn9eNqS%2BvekuPN6TYHOyM0xgH6srgjlxhKENt%2FbEUrbX2%2F%2F2TYak7W9BOMbyQKu708AZ1q%2BO%2FEFyPpuFQCx8FkmHukbJUVuF806k2VlcclmjPw8gxDHGbOxNIn2YCl3n2JyIGnhd3xF5se7XG197xXQc6Qg6X3zPGt8uacvLfgMocoV6Ery08Pm0Jp7OaLqgNWZXekB1dO9KPcQKizRub%2BI97wDscRFursXaChF6C%2FtRJd7vNNFColssTGUJSZyccsOhkwOd13K4QUcgp8ym%2BiPh0eskBGCkos9hM%2Bv0yy7KDYB%2BWQZKXCN0vcvB7qHWO4rtMyUscEEyO%2B4A3ehVgH0lVXoO0VyuFBTzn8V9DdvKAfw1vkq94ER63X3iyxJ%2FGD%2FEABtlY)_
* * *
Peter — I’m Tammy Baldwin, and I’m proud to represent Wisconsin in the United States Senate. I wanted to take this opportunity to tell you a little more about myself, why I ran for Senate, and why our campaign in Wisconsin is so important. **When I was a child, I was diagnosed with a serious illness and spent three months in the hospital.** I was raised by my grandparents, and when I got better, they looked for an insurance policy that would cover me in the future. However, because of my previous illness, they couldn’t find such a policy. Not from any insurer. Not at any price. They had to pay for my health care out of pocket — and they had to make enormous sacrifices to do so — all because I was a child who had been labeled with those words: “pre-existing condition.” Peter, I got into public service because I saw my grandparents stay up nights, worried sick that I would fall ill again and they wouldn't be able to afford my care. No one should ever have to go through that. **Like 133 million Americans, I know what it's like to have the label "pre-existing condition" attached to my care — and before the _Affordable Care Act_ was passed, many of us could be denied coverage.** Today, insurance companies can no longer discriminate against someone based on their pre-existing condition. I championed that health reform and fought to allow young people to stay on their parents’ insurance plans up to age 26. These policy changes have led to millions more Americans getting the health insurance they need. So, you can imagine my frustration whenever Republicans attack our health care or threaten protections for folks with pre-existing conditions. They’ve spent years playing politics with people’s lives. And if they’re successful, countless Americans could find themselves in a place where insurance companies, once again, write all the rules. **Peter, the people of Wisconsin did not send me to Washington to take people’s health care away, which is why I fought against Republican repeal efforts and why I will never back down.** Folks like you deserve leaders who work tirelessly to ensure every single person has access to quality, affordable health care, regardless of whether or not they have a pre-existing condition. So I am going to keep fighting to make sure we get those leaders elected, but I need your support. **[We must protect the _Affordable Care Act_ and elect more leaders who will fight to ensure every American has access to quality, affordable health care — regardless of whether or not they have a pre-existing condition. If you agree, sign your name alongside mine today:](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52198822/371572460/-1411723435?refcode=AU_STB_EG_WEL_PET_NTL_202210_SR1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83Njk1MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5NmZhMWRjMC0xMTQ3LWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgyNThkMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=c6YaCFbS11hG7LonW0S4HXEC_8rKIK__mMXanL5ekW4=&emci=cfe75184-56c6-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&emdi=96fa1dc0-1147-ed11-b495-002248258d38&ceid=35007871)** | | [Add your name](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52198824/371572462/-1411723435?refcode=AU_STB_EG_WEL_PET_NTL_202210_SR1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83Njk1MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5NmZhMWRjMC0xMTQ3LWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgyNThkMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=c6YaCFbS11hG7LonW0S4HXEC_8rKIK__mMXanL5ekW4=&emci=cfe75184-56c6-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&emdi=96fa1dc0-1147-ed11-b495-002248258d38&ceid=35007871)
---
I am not going to let anyone make me forget where I came from or why I got into public service in the first place. My own personal experience has always inspired my work to do everything I can to make sure that every American has quality, affordable health care coverage.
**That is a goal worth reaching, and, as Americans, we shouldn’t let anyone tell us we can’t.**
So long as you're with me, I know we can overcome any challenge we may face on the road ahead and stop the Republicans from taking away health insurance from millions of Americans once and for all.
Thank you for standing with me.
— Tammy
Paid for by Tammy Baldwin for Senate

Food prices have skyrocketed, and according to leading industry sources, grocery stores across the United States are worried about food shortages. Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us.
[View this message in your browser](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zgtd082leoh94sgbchi4he570j9unqtelunkav3g_rp22sh2s8i66or5c9j6eor3cjh238h5e8he485he5o75pt7kkpq2d9ieuqfbdbie4rrcdljkorrbdt469r31d5jekrq9onicbpr5c9l62qrcdtk6qon8o5meur7aphhcpr72cb5m5in8ctn6jir2t73e1rm4c776v970sj46oob4pjiegonco70mhij1o5l65iecpj664qbbcb0earmcc9gmmqefc5lclp2bs)
This sponsored message from Deroy Murdock is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2znje3d8afmm79ltgn9m4npsml8kdlfghdmge98no_rp22sh2s8i66or5c9j6eor3cjh2bs) Dear Fellow American, Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important. To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course entitled “The Second World Wars.” Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson, this course explores how the conflict’s diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. And it examines the key investments, strategies, and leaders that led the Allied powers to victory over the Axis. name: Al Franken
subject: Can I tell you about my friend, Josh Riley? He’s running for one of the most competitive House seats in the country, and I want to tell you why it would be good to have him in Congress.
body:
Dear Person Who Still Opens My Email,
I hardly ever ask anything of you. Unless you’re also on my other list of people who I constantly ask to contribute to something I don’t think I can legally mention here. (Though it’s a really good thing.)
I want you to give to Josh Riley’s campaign for the open House in seat in NY’s 19th district. And to CommonGood too. Please donate now! [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_riley?refcode==20221007_CGVA_Riley]
Josh was my Judiciary Committee counsel, and I cannot say enough good things about him. But here’s some.
Josh grew up in the district in a working-class neighborhood of Endicott, NY.
After graduating from Harvard Law School, Josh moved to Florida to work on a landmark civil rights lawsuit representing kids from low-income families who were having difficulty accessing the healthcare services they needed.
Josh really, really cares about all the stuff I care about.
Josh is the hardest worker I know.
Together we passed bills expanding rights for survivors of domestic abuse and providing new funding for addiction treatment and mental health programs.
We also made a lot of Republican witnesses look very bad. Josh is my friend.
And finally, this open seat is considered one of the most competitive in the nation.
DONATE $25 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_riley?refcode==20221007_CGVA_Riley&amount=25]
DONATE $35 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_riley?refcode==20221007_CGVA_Riley&amount=35]
DONATE $50 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_riley?refcode==20221007_CGVA_Riley&amount=50]

DONATE $250 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_riley?refcode==20221007_CGVA_Riley&amount=250]
Donate ANY [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_riley?refcode==20221007_CGVA_Riley]
Control of the House is up for grabs. Please help Josh win this one for all of us.
This is important. To me. And to our nation.
Thanks,
Al

Voting by mail is one of the easiest ways to cast your ballot and help your candidate win.

[**Will you help Democrats win this year by requesting your vote-by-mail ballot? Make your request online today if you're a Pennsylvania voter,**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52206390/371601564/-1813083118?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDU4NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxZDFlY2UyMS0xZDQ3LWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgyNThkMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=X-a1MTqnWHPivp7YDpyeTDl5wCqIv8c94GJMYOMyBY0=&emci=242b9a46-4f46-ed11-b495-002248258d38&emdi=1d1ece21-1d47-ed11-b495-002248258d38&ceid=8943725#/OnlineAbsenteeBegin)[**or visit IWillVote.com if you vote in another state.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52206391/371601565/-1612268846?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDU4NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxZDFlY2UyMS0xZDQ3LWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgyNThkMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=X-a1MTqnWHPivp7YDpyeTDl5wCqIv8c94GJMYOMyBY0=&emci=242b9a46-4f46-ed11-b495-002248258d38&emdi=1d1ece21-1d47-ed11-b495-002248258d38&ceid=8943725)

When I woke up this morning, I was filled with gratitude. Fighting for our common good alongside all of you is an honor, **and I know we are ready to take that fight to Congress.**

Our campaign resonates with western Pennsylvania families because we’re fighting for the things that matter most – **bringing our supply chains back home, stronger protection for workers and unions, taking on unchecked corporate power, making billionaires and big corporations pay their fair share, protecting our right to vote, ensuring that women and girls across the country have access to legal abortion, and so much more.**

I know we still have challenges ahead. The corporate executive I’m running against is bankrolling his own campaign, and the dark-money groups and National Republicans propping him up are spending **more than $6 million** to attack my record on TV. **To fight back, it’s going to take all of us.**

**So here’s the plan, Derek:** We need to take the fight for our common good to the voters, which means keeping our TV and digital ads running up until the election, knocking on every single door we can in Beaver and Allegheny Counties, and talking to as many voters as possible about the issues that matter most.

**[But doing all of that is expensive, Derek, and unlike my opponent, I’m not backed by mega-rich corporate PACs. | | Dear Friend, There’s this notion nowadays that just because an idea is popular, it must be true.

It’s a narrative that you’ll often see pushed by a dysfunctional media or toxic culture. And as long as the idea is considered “correct” by the “right” people like TV talking heads, celebrities, or the masses on social media, the general public believes it.

name: Tiffany Smiley
subject: This is a long, but very personal message for you, Peter
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Smiley for Washington, Inc
body:
| |
---
| | | Peter,

My name is Tiffany Smiley and I wanted to tell you a little bit about myself and why I'm running for the U.S. Senate in Washington.

I grew up in Pasco, Washington where I helped out on my family's farm and learned the value of hard work.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61548866:6a0RTeVQN:m:1:3317145305:060B1514A1B8F6FF6EC4BEC2BCC2EE50:r "I helped out on my family’s farm and learned the value of
hard work.")
---

I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College, where I also studied to become a nurse so I could pursue my passion of helping others in need.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61548866:6a0RTeVQN:m:1:3317145305:060B1514A1B8F6FF6EC4BEC2BCC2EE50:r "I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College")
---

I married my high school sweetheart Scotty, who went on to serve our country in the United States Army while I started my nursing career.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61548866:6a0RTeVQN:m:1:3317145305:060B1514A1B8F6FF6EC4BEC2BCC2EE50:r "I married my high school sweetheart Scotty")
---

In 2005, I received a call that changed both our lives forever, Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq, causing him to fall into a coma and permanently lose sight in both of his eyes.

I immediately booked a flight for Walter Reed Medical Center to be by Scotty's side.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61548866:6a0RTeVQN:m:1:3317145305:060B1514A1B8F6FF6EC4BEC2BCC2EE50:r "Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq")
---

When I arrived, Scotty was still in trauma care, and I was informed that he would never be able to serve his nation again in uniform. They even asked me to sign a document, right there on the spot, consenting to Scotty's immediate discharge from the Army.
_**I refused. **_
Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61548866:6a0RTeVQN:m:1:3317145305:060B1514A1B8F6FF6EC4BEC2BCC2EE50:r "Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and
every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.")
---

Scotty went on to serve as America's first blind active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61548866:6a0RTeVQN:m:1:3317145305:060B1514A1B8F6FF6EC4BEC2BCC2EE50:r "Scotty went on to serve as America’s first blind
active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way. ")
---

It's not every day you hear about American women going up against the U.S. Military. But we defied the government in a big way--_and won._

We stood up to a broken bureaucracy because it was the right thing to do. I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61548866:6a0RTeVQN:m:1:3317145305:060B1514A1B8F6FF6EC4BEC2BCC2EE50:r "I will always stand up for our
heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.")
---

In 2007, we welcomed our first child. While Scotty will never be able to 'see' our children's faces, he's always been an incredible father and hero to our boys.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61548866:6a0RTeVQN:m:1:3317145305:060B1514A1B8F6FF6EC4BEC2BCC2EE50:r "In 2007, we welcomed our first child.")
---

Now, our family is taking on a new challenge. I'm running for US Senate to help families across the country achieve the American Dream and save our country from Joe Biden and Patty Murray.

I will take the same fight and optimistic spirit I've shown throughout my life to help Washington families secure a better life. I believe that now, more than ever, Washingtonians need a voice to find solutions to their unique problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61548866:6a0RTeVQN:m:1:3317145305:060B1514A1B8F6FF6EC4BEC2BCC2EE50:r "Washingtonians need a voice to find
solutions to their unique problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress.")
---

My family began this journey in the halls of Walter Reed and we look forward to continuing this journey in the halls of the United States Capitol.

I would love for the next photo in this story to be us winning this race with my family by my side.

We can't do that, however, without your help, friend. _**[So please, can you chip in just a few bucks to help us keep up the momentum we've achieved so far.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61548866:6a0RTeVQN:m:1:3317145305:060B1514A1B8F6FF6EC4BEC2BCC2EE50:r "So please, can you chip in just a
few bucks to help us keep up the momentum we’ve achieved so far. ")**_

---
| | | [KEEP TIFFANY IN THE FIGHT](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61548866:6a0RTeVQN:m:1:3317145305:060B1514A1B8F6FF6EC4BEC2BCC2EE50:r "KEEP
TIFFANY IN THE FIGHT")
---
| | | [STAND UP FOR AMERICA](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61548866:6a0RTeVQN:m:1:3317145305:060B1514A1B8F6FF6EC4BEC2BCC2EE50:r "STAND UP FOR AMERICA")
---

I know with your support we can win this.

Sincerely,

Tiffany Smiley

---
| |

---
* * *
---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61548867:6a0RTeVQN:m:1:3317145305:060B1514A1B8F6FF6EC4BEC2BCC2EE50:r "All Eyes On Washington")
---
Hey, it's Tiffany Smiley.

The Washington Senate race is now the #1 battleground race in the COUNTRY!

Needless to say, all eyes are on us. We are in the FINAL DAYS until the November election, and Patty Murray is flooding millions into our state.

We are in an uphill battle, and I can't make it up to the top without you. Not just Washingtonians, but all Americans deserve a real leader with real solutions. Together, we can ensure that the American Dream is not lost.

_**[Rush support now to be a part of history](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61548867:6a0RTeVQN:m:1:3317145305:060B1514A1B8F6FF6EC4BEC2BCC2EE50:r "Rush support now to be a part of history")**_.

Let's raise money and WIN,

Tiffany Smiley

---
| | | [JOIN TEAM SMILEY](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61548867:6a0RTeVQN:m:1:3317145305:060B1514A1B8F6FF6EC4BEC2BCC2EE50:r "JOIN TEAM SMILEY")
---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61548868:6a0RTeVQN:m:1:3317145305:060B1514A1B8F6FF6EC4BEC2BCC2EE50:r "Alert!")
---

Team Smiley here with a RED ALERT!

You know we don't often beg, plead, or panic, but Tiffany is facing a key deadline, and we're OUT of time.

Whether or not you choose to act will decide the outcome of the Washington U.S. Senate Election:

Tiffany is currently being outraised and outspent by her 30-year incumbent opponent. We need all hands on deck to turn things around TODAY.

There's no time to wait on the sidelines.

_**[That's why we're HUMBLY asking for your help in the next 15 minutes!](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61548869:6a0RTeVQN:m:1:3317145305:060B1514A1B8F6FF6EC4BEC2BCC2EE50:r "That's why we're HUMBLY asking for your help in the next 15 minutes!")**_

This is our only chance to make history and restore a brighter future for Washington and all of America. We need Tiffany Smiley in the U.S. Senate, plain and simple.

Our team doesn't want to have to deliver bad news to Tiffany later today, so we're calling on our grassroots team, including YOU, to help increase our momentum!

Tiffany is a veterans' advocate and mother of 3! She is the new, fresh leadership we desperately need in Washington! Tiffany will be your #1 supporter in the U.S. Senate.

We're out of time. There's nowhere else to turn. Tiffany needs us at this moment. _**[Step up now!](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61548869:6a0RTeVQN:m:1:3317145305:060B1514A1B8F6FF6EC4BEC2BCC2EE50:r "Step up
now!")**_

---

subject: Joe Biden’s economic myth – update from your favorite think tank
body:
| | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/mspolicy/leadershipacademy-8132644?e=5703353baa)
---
| |
---
|
Dear #VALUE!,
**Joe Biden recently took to twitter to inform us that he was “sick and tired of trickle-down economics”.** It is an approach, said the President, that “has never worked”.
---
|
---
| **But was "trickle-down economics" ever tried? **

For years the left has attacked "trickle-down economics", but I have never actually come across anyone proposing to make poor people prosper by enriching the rich.

**Trickle-down economics is a myth.** It no more exists than the Loch Ness monster.

Why does the President feel compelled to attack something that doesn’t exist? In common with every progressive leader since Bill Clinton, Biden uses attacks on a non-existent economic policy in order to misrepresent conservative tax policy.

**Biden feels the need to attack conservative tax cuts as ‘trickle-down’ because the success of conservative tax cuts is a threat to Washington DC’s agenda.**

When Mississippi passed the Tax Freedom Act earlier this year, we implemented one of the largest tax cuts in our state’s history. Cutting the state income tax in Mississippi meant that we joined forces with Texas, Tennessee and Florida in lowering the tax burden.
---
| [ ](https://mspolicy.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=60d4052c66b6745831ccdf7c8&id=41961d9390&e=5703353baa)
---
Alex Epstein talks to Douglas about energy policy
| **Progressive politicians in Washington DC cannot afford to allow the idea of tax cuts as a way of producing prosperity to take hold.** If other states join Mississippi’s example in cutting taxes – as Missouri did this week - it will undermine the progressive claim that we need higher taxes and more government.

**The federal government has only introduced substantial tax cuts on three or four occasions in recent US history;** under Ronald Reagan in 1981 and 1986, under George Bush the younger in 2001-03 and then under Donald Trump in 2017.

On every one of those occasions, the left condemned them as ‘trickle-down economics!’. In retrospect, the biggest beneficiaries of the Reagan, Bush and Trump tax cuts were middle income Americans.

If, as the left suggests, the conservatives introduced tax cuts as part of a diabolical scheme to benefit only the rich, they failed. **The Reagan, Bush and Trump tax cuts helped all of America prosper.**

Ironically, perhaps, the Reagan tax cuts even benefited progressives. The tax cuts of the 1980s produced such a tsunami of prosperity into the 1990s, the additional tax revenues that they generated allowed President Clinton to run a small budget surplus.

Tax cuts clearly work. There’s nothing ‘trickle-down’ about them.

**Mississippi is on the front line in the fight for America’s future by showing that tax cuts offer an alternative to Biden’s tax-and-spend approach.** No wonder the President is so keen to attack.

Have a great weekend!
---
| [Forward this email to a friend!](https://mspolicy.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=60d4052c66b6745831ccdf7c8&id=1a334aecae&e=5703353baa "Forward this email to a friend!")
---
| |
---
Warm regards,

Douglas Carswell
President & CEO

clean_body: | | | | | | Dear #VALUE!, Joe Biden recently took to twitter to inform us that he was “sick and tired of trickle-down economics”. It is an approach, said the President, that “has never worked”. | | But was "trickle-down economics" ever tried? For years the left has attacked "trickle-down economics", but I have never actually come across anyone proposing to make poor people prosper by enriching the rich. Trickle-down economics is a myth. It no more exists than the Loch Ness monster. Why does the President feel compelled to attack something that doesn’t exist? In common with every progressive leader since Bill Clinton, Biden uses attacks on a non-existent economic policy in order to misrepresent conservative tax policy. Biden feels the need to attack conservative tax cuts as ‘trickle-down’ because the success of conservative tax cuts is a threat to Washington DC’s agenda. When Mississippi passed the Tax Freedom Act earlier this year, we implemented one of the largest tax cuts in our state’s history. Cutting the state income tax in Mississippi meant that we joined forces with Texas, Tennessee and Florida in lowering the tax burden. | Alex Epstein talks to Douglas about energy policy | Progressive politicians in Washington DC cannot afford to allow the idea of tax cuts as a way of producing prosperity to take hold. If other states join Mississippi’s example in cutting taxes – as Missouri did this week - it will undermine the progressive claim that we need higher taxes and more government. The federal government has only introduced substantial tax cuts on three or four occasions in recent US history; under Ronald Reagan in 1981 and 1986, under George Bush the younger in 2001-03 and then under Donald Trump in 2017. On every one of those occasions, the left condemned them as ‘trickle-down economics!’. In retrospect, the biggest beneficiaries of the Reagan, Bush and Trump tax cuts were middle income Americans. If, as the left suggests, the conservatives introduced tax cuts as part of a diabolical scheme to benefit only the rich, they failed. The Reagan, Bush and Trump tax cuts helped all of America prosper. Ironically, perhaps, the Reagan tax cuts even benefited progressives. The tax cuts of the 1980s produced such a tsunami of prosperity into the 1990s, the additional tax revenues that they generated allowed President Clinton to run a small budget surplus. Tax cuts clearly work. There’s nothing ‘trickle-down’ about them. Mississippi is on the front line in the fight for America’s future by showing that tax cuts offer an alternative to Biden’s tax-and-spend approach. No wonder the President is so keen to attack. Have a great weekend! | "Forward this email to a friend!" | | Warm regards, Douglas Carswell President & CEO | Ps. I thought you might like to read about education policy in our state. | | |

**Today marks just _one month_ out from Election Day.**

Hi friend,

This past Tuesday, I had the pleasure of being in Worthington for a Q & A with community members. As _The Globe_ appropriately noted: [Ettinger takes the stage alone when Finstad doesn’t participate in Worthington Forum.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52212310/371624404/1170709658?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzMwMCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3Zjg0YjJhZi0yYTQ3LWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgyNThkMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=hRDgjUsIGzG49vMSOxyp0HKNKkPS8QLs1ujEvW2yQ6k=&emci=3b8900d3-1f47-ed11-b495-002248258d38&emdi=7f84b2af-2a47-ed11-b495-002248258d38&ceid=5460736)

I shared with the audience that my opponent calls himself a conserviative fighter. I, on the other hand, believe that people in our district who are not conservative also deserve representation in Washington. We don’t need more fighters in Washington. That fighting mentality is part of what led to the January 6 tragedy that happened on Capitol Hill. Instead of a conservative fighter, I will be a main-street problem solver.

I shared with voters my middle of the road stance on issues ranging from improving bipartisanship to creating standards of operation that keep our communities safe while properly funding law enforcement agencies.

People asked insightful questions on a variety of topics, including inflation, education, and access to reproductive health care, which you can read about [here](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52212316/371624408/1170709658?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzMwMCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3Zjg0YjJhZi0yYTQ3LWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgyNThkMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=hRDgjUsIGzG49vMSOxyp0HKNKkPS8QLs1ujEvW2yQ6k=&emci=3b8900d3-1f47-ed11-b495-002248258d38&emdi=7f84b2af-2a47-ed11-b495-002248258d38&ceid=5460736).

I greatly enjoyed spending time with community members in Worthington, as I do with folks across the district.

From Worthington to Winona, our campaign is showing up!

I shared with voters my middle of the road stance on issues ranging from improving bipartisanship to creating standards of operation that keep our communities safe while properly funding law enforcement agencies. People asked insightful questions on a variety of topics, including inflation, education, and access to reproductive health care, which you can read about . I greatly enjoyed spending time with community members in Worthington, as I do with folks across the district. From Worthington to Winona, our campaign is showing up! # Hi ,

In case you missed it, on Monday night I showed up to debate my opponent on BEK TV North Dakota. He was a no show.

This isn’t new. That’s why I’m running to replace him because **North Dakotans need someone who will show up for them**.

I’m thrilled to let you know that we received an endorsement from the **National Women’s Political Caucus**! In their endorsement they said, “we know you’ll continue to fight for us.”
**They are right, I will keep fighting for North Dakotans.**
But we need your help so we can spread our message far and wide - this campaign is within firing range of taking this seat on November 8th.

There’s so much on the line when you cast your ballot:
* Social security and Medicare
* Economic issues and energy
* Our farms and farmers
* And so much more.

**Please [click here](https://katrinaforussenate.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2bb537a705e300eb5ec0192d9&id=e993ceeea6&e=101b417fd1) to chip in today
so we can keep up the fight and get our message out to all voters in North Dakota.**
If we haven’t met yet, I’d love to see you **at 2 PM (Saturday, October 8 th) at the Reproductive Rights Rally at the Town Square in Grand Forks**. I’ll be talking about the importance of our fight to protect women’s access to reproductive health care.

**[Please click here](https://katrinaforussenate.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2bb537a705e300eb5ec0192d9&id=3719697977&e=101b417fd1)if you can help make phone calls, knock on doors or write letters to the editor of your local newspaper.**

See you on the trail!

Best,
Katrina

body:
#
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20221008-1?amount=5&refcode=em20221008-7616&refcode2=7616_434096_B40f0t&akid=7616%2E434096%2EB40f0t)
Derek — I write to you today, not as an actor or a former (fictional) president, but as an American concerned about losing our Democratic Senate majority: **Donald Trump is in Nevada today for a MAGA rally to defeat Sen. Catherine Cortez Masto (D) in the race that will decide Senate control.**
If Trump tips the scales in favor of his hand-picked extremist, Adam Laxalt (R) — if they defeat Sen. Cortez Masto — then Democrats _will_ lose the Senate and Mitch McConnell _will_ regain his iron grip on power.
I refuse to sit on the sidelines and watch our country return to dark days where truth is thwarted by lies and conspiracies and where the selfish interests of deranged extremists reign supreme. **That's why I need you to join me in fighting back against Trump and helping Sen. Cortez Masto protect this seat and our majority.**
**[I’m personally asking you: Will you split $5 between Catherine’s campaign and John Fetterman to combat Trump's attacks, keep Nevada blue and defend our Senate majority?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20221008-1?amount=5&refcode=em20221008-7616&refcode2=7616_434096_B40f0t&akid=7616%2E434096%2EB40f0t)**
**[Contribute $5](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20221008-1?amount=5&refcode=em20221008-7616&refcode2=7616_434096_B40f0t&akid=7616%2E434096%2EB40f0t)**
I've been an activist my entire life, Derek. I've witnessed moments where people came together by the thousands, by the _millions,_ to usher in great progress for this nation.
But I've also seen the consequences when not enough people rise to the urgency of the moment before them – and right now I can say to you with confidence that we've never faced a more urgent, a more important, midterm election.
If Republicans flip the one seat they need to retake control – if they flip _this_ seat – they will usher in an era of zero bodily autonomy for women, of further attacks on voting and free and fair elections, of turning a blind eye to climate change. They will roll out the red carpet for the return of the impeached former president.
**It's why Donald Trump himself is in Nevada right now holding one of his infamous, dangerous MAGA rallies: to defeat Catherine Cortez Masto and begin his return to power. We must do everything we can to stop him, and that means ensuring Catherine has the resources to fight back and win.**
**[Please, rush $5 or whatever you can spare to fight back against Trump, help Catherine Cortez Masto and John Fetterman win in Nevada and Pennsylvania, and protect our Democratic Senate majority.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20221008-1?amount=5&refcode=em20221008-7616&refcode2=7616_434096_B40f0t&akid=7616%2E434096%2EB40f0t)**
Thank you,
Martin Sheen

With Republicans in Washington promising to ban abortion nationwide, **Vermont cannot risk sending someone to Congress who is not 100% pro-choice.** This election, we have the opportunity to elect someone who will work to protect abortion rights, who will fight for working people and not the wealthy few, protect our planet, and defend our democracy._That’s Becca._ Here is how we win:

Friend,

Next week, mail-in ballots begin arriving at Central Valley homes, and the choice couldn’t be more clear.

My opponent Kevin McCarthy has left our communities behind. He’s spent the last 15 years playing partisan politics and aligning himself with far-right extremists. He’s not in this race to support the Central Valley or High Desert -- he’s in it for himself.

I got into this race to build a better future for families in our district. I’m not a career politician, friend, and I’m not interested in becoming one. **I’m ready to defeat Kevin McCarthy in the fight of his career.**

As we head into the final month of this campaign, here are a few ways your dollars can still make a huge impact:
* Funding postage and mailers to get my positive message to undecided voters
* Feeding volunteers and paying for gas to help them knock doors across CA-20
* Supporting our get-out-the-vote efforts to make sure Democrats show up to the polls

Please chip in whatever you can to help us DEFEAT Kevin McCarthy on November 8.

Here’s a good link: **[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mw-v4-q3-2022?refcode=dpwillis67@gmail.com](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52215520/371631429/1594291383?refcode=em-10.08.22-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDU3NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0ZDJiZTA3Ni0yZTQ3LWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgyNThkMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=OfEsAQZsbx02yzkw_uLNUF__bDR6a0b4ywCAzhDKAKs=)**

name: Tiffany Smiley
subject: My story in pictures

body:
My name is Tiffany Smiley and I wanted to tell you a little bit about myself and why I’m running for the U.S. Senate in Washin

| |
---
| | | Friend,

My name is Tiffany Smiley and I wanted to tell you a little bit about myself and why I'm running for the U.S. Senate in Washington.

I grew up in Pasco, Washington where I helped out on my family's farm and learned the value of hard work.

---
| [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zk2nelte3jot8cco5ohkc2e0uffg9jakec20q7h0_rp22sh2s8i66or5c9gmco36cph2bs "I helped out on my family’s farm and learned the value of hard work.")
---

I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College, where I also studied to become a nurse so I could pursue my passion of helping others in need.

---
| [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2ze81t0huuo14nupg3l7qpdvr4u7kpci9hi4nkbjg_rp22sh2s8i66or5c9gmco36cph2bs "I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College")
---

I married my high school sweetheart Scotty, who went on to serve our country in the United States Army while I started my nursing career.

---
| [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z3u9cecar2ump6smh0gv9dgmam2tsog0u8vfjiv0_rp22sh2s8i66or5c9gmco36cph2bs "I married my high school sweetheart Scotty")
---

In 2005, I received a call that changed both our lives forever, Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq, causing him to fall into a coma and permanently lose sight in both of his eyes.

I immediately booked a flight for Walter Reed Medical Center to be by Scotty's side.

---
| [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z5olrf71usqaj4de4to93js8m6gq6tjbagu0s8b0_rp22sh2s8i66or5c9gmco36cph2bs "Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq")
---

When I arrived, Scotty was still in trauma care, and I was informed that he would never be able to serve his nation again in uniform. They even asked me to sign a document, right there on the spot, consenting to Scotty's immediate discharge from the Army.
_**I refused. **_
Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.

---
| [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zk4qnitikm3jotbcm6s63bdu97mobtn0fvavsbo8_rp22sh2s8i66or5c9gmco36cph2bs "Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.")
---

Scotty went on to serve as America's first blind active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way.

---
| [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2znf4nel8ke3hsbph2ip77of59i91lb59k3h53hjg_rp22sh2s8i66or5c9gmco36cph2bs "Scotty went on to serve as America’s first blind active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way.")
---

It's not every day you hear about American women going up against the U.S. Military. But we defied the government in a big way--_and won._

We stood up to a broken bureaucracy because it was the right thing to do. I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.

---
| [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zutqsishc1hbppfdkgk0210pno6p6dr6lltpphd8_rp22sh2s8i66or5c9gmco36cph2bs "I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.")
---

In 2007, we welcomed our first child. While Scotty will never be able to 'see' our children's faces, he's always been an incredible father and hero to our boys.

---
| [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z0vaht32n655rpvm9b97t6l31lq142771evrtbbo_rp22sh2s8i66or5c9gmco36cph2bs "In 2007, we welcomed our first child.")
---

Now, our family is taking on a new challenge. I'm running for US Senate to help families across the country achieve the American Dream and save our country from Joe Biden and Patty Murray.

I will take the same fight and optimistic spirit I've shown throughout my life to help Washington families secure a better life. I believe that now, more than ever, Washingtonians need a voice to find solutions to their unique problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress.

---
| [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z14kihch9qedfb9g546l26ru5ue3hunof0t42i98_rp22sh2s8i66or5c9gmco36cph2bs "Washingtonians need a voice to find solutions to their unique problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress.")
---

My family began this journey in the halls of Walter Reed and we look forward to continuing this journey in the halls of the United States Capitol.

I would love for the next photo in this story to be us winning this race with my family by my side.

We can't do that, however, without your help, friend. _**[So please, can you chip in just a few bucks to help us keep up the momentum we've achieved so far.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z7dtphdjfg81qdv3a96535b217uuanv6qv0ji0m8_rp22sh2s8i66or5c9gmco36cph2bs "So please, can you chip in just a few bucks to help us keep up the momentum we’ve achieved so far.")**_

---
| | | [KEEP TIFFANY IN THE FIGHT](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zh50h6r3frjqqgslll29lp5nnc5id4shfvb3ikbo_rp22sh2s8i66or5c9gmco36cph2bs "KEEP TIFFANY IN THE FIGHT")
---
| | | [STAND UP FOR AMERICA](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z9l328ebs05ak1gj4fku1fqu1nd1s75k85l7g87g_rp22sh2s8i66or5c9gmco36cph2bs "STAND UP FOR AMERICA")
---

I know with your support we can win this.

Sincerely,

Tiffany Smiley

---
| |

---
* * *
---
| [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zc8532i36kt6kl1ktr9p4oajmkhgq24ctb37gcd0_rp22sh2s8i66or5c9gmco36cph2bs "All Eyes On Washington")
---
Hey, it's Tiffany Smiley.

The Washington Senate race is now the #1 battleground race in the COUNTRY!

Needless to say, all eyes are on us. We are in the FINAL DAYS until the November election, and Patty Murray is flooding millions into our state.

We are in an uphill battle, and I can't make it up to the top without you. Not just Washingtonians, but all Americans deserve a real leader with real solutions. Together, we can ensure that the American Dream is not lost.

_**[Rush support now to be a part of history](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zr6omtfu23896bt2aqm88j4qnnkt1d81l7gkdug8_rp22sh2s8i66or5c9gmco36cph2bs "Rush support now to be a part of history")**_.

Let's raise money and WIN,

Tiffany Smiley

---
| | | [JOIN TEAM SMILEY](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zp3aaf4tsrg04m19us2jneaehbiqrqkum8jd3tk0_rp22sh2s8i66or5c9gmco36cph2bs "JOIN TEAM SMILEY")
---
| [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zm703rhp8rt91as5q90pa0cg4udsha68t6qkikj0_rp22sh2s8i66or5c9gmco36cph2bs "Alert!")
---

Team Smiley here with a RED ALERT!

You know we don't often beg, plead, or panic, but Tiffany is facing a key deadline, and we're OUT of time.

Whether or not you choose to act will decide the outcome of the Washington U.S. Senate Election:

Tiffany is currently being outraised and outspent by her 30-year incumbent opponent. We need all hands on deck to turn things around TODAY.

There's no time to wait on the sidelines.

_**[That's why we're HUMBLY asking for your help in the next 15 minutes!](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zmuo6rc46ihsqmsu3o1ubn1mnpk339jjd7tk7ec0_rp22sh2s8i66or5c9gmco36cph2bs "That's why we're HUMBLY asking for your help in the next 15 minutes!")**_

This is our only chance to make history and restore a brighter future for Washington and all of America. We need Tiffany Smiley in the U.S. Senate, plain and simple.

Our team doesn't want to have to deliver bad news to Tiffany later today, so we're calling on our grassroots team, including YOU, to help increase our momentum!

Tiffany is a veterans' advocate and mother of 3! She is the new, fresh leadership we desperately need in Washington! Tiffany will be your #1 supporter in the U.S. Senate.

We're out of time. There's nowhere else to turn. Tiffany needs us at this moment. _**[Step up now!](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z9fd9jgkbuhsud1ogkrusggfodmk2u985mb075t0_rp22sh2s8i66or5c9gmco36cph2bs "Step up now!")**_

I’m shocked at just how low Nancy Mace is willing to go to cling to her MAGA fame. She literally is inciting violence against trans kids and against doctors, but she doesn’t care as long as it gets her an interview on Fox News or some more Twitter followers.

body:
| | | [](https://rondesantis.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=22432bec7f541233c6007cfc2&id=b87966b89a&e=fdefed58de)
---
Friend,
As Democrat-run cities are besieged by crime and mayhem, Florida is supporting law enforcement and keeping our communities safe.Far-Left extremists are hell-bent on smearing and defunding the law enforcement officers who risk their lives daily to protect our communities.Leftist politicians and Soros-backed prosecutors are enabling chaos and undermining the law enforcement profession by letting violent criminals walk free with hardly a slap on the wrist.In other states, repeat offenders are receiving unlimited “get out of jail free” cards and free rein to disrespect the rule of law.[**Reject the Left’s woke agenda – Rush in your support >>>**](https://rondesantis.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=22432bec7f541233c6007cfc2&id=38246f94d2&e=fdefed58de)The Left and their corporate media lapdogs don’t want you to see the destruction their woke agenda is inflicting on communities across the nation, so they’re doing what they do best: deflecting.My opponent has not been shy about his support for the reallocation and defunding of police departments. But unlike my opponent and the Soros-funded prosecutors whose pro-crime ideology has made once-great cities unlivable,**I’m not beholden to anyone but the people of Florida.****And as Governor, I have worked to ensure that Florida is a law-and-order state.** Supporting our law enforcement heroes, pursuing justice for victims, and keeping our communities safe are not Left vs. Right issues. They’re right vs. wrong issues – which is why I’ve been endorsed by Democrat elected officials like Palm Beach County Commissioner Dave Kerner. As a former law enforcement officer, Dave rejects those in his party – including my opponent – who have embraced the disastrous “defund the police” agenda.When I look a police officer in the eye and say, “I have your back,” I don’t just say it –**I follow through**.
[](https://rondesantis.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=22432bec7f541233c6007cfc2&id=2d0f5934ba&e=fdefed58de)
As Governor, I have a responsibility to lead. But I also have the opportunity to make a difference and get things done.In Florida, we’ve led with purpose and conviction. Because of that, we’ve produced results better than anybody thought possible.
The good news is... we’re just getting started.My opponent’s extreme agenda and admiration of Soros-backed policies only fuel my resolve to fight woke tyranny and Keep Florida Free.D.C. Democrats are desperate to derail our progress and turn our great state into a crime-ridden dystopia.
That’s why your support is so important, Lavern. There’s more on the line than just celebrating a victory in November.We’re in a fight to safeguard our state.The safety of our families and our communities is on the line. We cannot sit idly by as far-Left extremists try to dismantle our way of life and trample on the rule of law.
They would love nothing more than to see Florida face the same fate as progressive jurisdictions overrun by violent crime. We cannot allow their twisted nightmare to become reality.
[](https://rondesantis.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=22432bec7f541233c6007cfc2&id=d296ffbe7c&e=fdefed58de)
With only 32 days until Election Day, we MUST stay ahead of the far-Left extremists threatening our safety.Can I count on your support in our fight to protect Florida from the Left’s woke agenda? >>>

name: Jim DeMint
subject: Strong Leaders Have Strong Staff
body:
| | |
---
|
---
Fellow Conservative: Like you, we also have high hopes for November. But as you know, conservatives need to be thinking past the mid-terms, too.
**That’s where CPI comes in.**
In January, dozens of new conservative members of the House and Senate are going to come to Washington with targets on their backs.
Establishment leaders, lobbyists, and Beltway insiders will all get to work to turn America First candidates into Swamp creatures. Wolves will pose as shepherds, offering guidance and friendship. They’ll offer fundraising help, hiring advice, and the “right connections.”
_**CPI’s Staffing and Training Services department is the antidote to this political poison.**_
Our team of principled, savvy Hill veterans will be there for newly elected conservative members every step of the way: from their election to their swearing-in and beyond.
CPI’s training courses are the most rigorous and sought-after in Washington. We teach staff what party leaders don’t want them to know: the intricacies of policy, legislative and communications strategy, and also how to use House and Senate rules to fight back against the Establishment. We work hand-in-glove with new members and chiefs of staff to hire their teams – from gathering resumes to interviewing to final decisions.
**[Please help us ramp up our staffing preparations with a tax-deductible gift to CPI today!](http://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=de798d56a1c14620b64af0669ac7f7a6&_e=nQ_7xLcJEefjf7DqTl6xg0BiOSftYYTrGrwlgsTkx5hvMjrzjzOGS970M4iU4D1AThVlTiu2FlD0oxkd5mWQ7V90jSQ4UBEEFtSu_y0wgDNi737ohvx3e8CLgTTfi63FfJm5JTLk2Zxn2tVbxbXI3KIuW7hxISC_45XEdmDppNiNElaGS9PsDaxebQEwfZkeiOXTSz-pksxxvWMRy9vt0em2NLEQGRY4nI8ylTZRJ25lGitsZ26ksC1pp2XQR8iy_ERLIOxU4TFyfjjmhJLNmkh-TPo0tma8QYoo6equhUuPsIFhyq-luJwrjJcfAILhF8RmUxD6b9oDH4C4vywrXw%3D%3D)**
As 2021 freshman Rep. Byron Donalds (FL) said:
_“They didn’t just send me some resumes of potential staff members and wish me well. You have to understand: CPI interviews and vets young conservatives all year round to identify and then recommend the best, smartest, and toughest staff.”_
---
---
We are changing the way conservative Representatives and Senators work – honing, coordinating, amplifying. Many members now send their entire staff over to CPI for training retreats.
And we know that this year, CPI’s **Staffing and Training Services** will be more important than ever. The new Congress will have more anti-establishment conservative freshman members. The hundreds of staffers that get hired in personal and committee offices will help determine the trajectory of Congress for a generation.
**[With your help, CPI will be ready.](http://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=de798d56a1c14620b64af0669ac7f7a6&_e=nQ_7xLcJEefjf7DqTl6xg0BiOSftYYTrGrwlgsTkx5hvMjrzjzOGS970M4iU4D1AThVlTiu2FlD0oxkd5mWQ7V90jSQ4UBEEFtSu_y0wgDNi737ohvx3e8CLgTTfi63FfJm5JTLk2Zxn2tVbxbXI3KIuW7hxISC_45XEdmDppNiNElaGS9PsDaxebQEwfZke4Tk48ACNm6YgPrigpr5IPlJXykgRSrFIekCq2v7MH9kLTyc7ygjoZT3OEy8kQvyQV9SmvKn5EwCjAWe_r6eeZJJiRfK7eR0hxP1uPTVAmzqjQZhCVQs4UbSOnUk_yihkQVyIjqb78xcf571kwNlV9g%3D%3D)**
We have increased the size and scope of our operations to meet the growing demand. We are redoubling our training, recruitment, and vetting work so that the most conservative freshman class of new members in history will also be the best prepared.

With your help, we will keep working, keep teaching, and keep partnering with conservatives in Washington and across the country. America’s emerging conservative leadership, when it comes to Washington next year, will have a home and a headquarters at the Conservative Partnership Institute.
Thank you for considering this request and for doing so much to help fight for the principles of freedom that make America great. Sincerely,
---

Jim DeMint
CPI Chairman

Friend,
I've been named the most vulnerable Democratic senator up for reelection by NPR – so with the stakes higher than ever in this race, I've got a simple question for you:
What would you do if I told you how your donation of $25 today would help keep Georgia blue and defend our Democratic Senate majority?
Would you give $25, knowing it would keep the message of our people-powered campaign on TVs and computer screens and radios across Georgia?
Would you give $25, knowing it would keep our offices open and incredible staff on the ground speaking heart-to-heart with Georgia voters?
Would you give $25, knowing thousands of other grassroots supporters like you are doing the same so that my campaign can reach every corner of Georgia?
Friend, I'm not taking a cent from corporate PACs. Never have, never will. We defied the pundits and the odds and the hundreds of millions in Republican dollars spent to flip Georgia blue last year, and I know we can keep Georgia blue – one $25 donation at a time.
So please, with polling showing me 1 point down in the race that will decide Senate control, will you give $25 or more right now -- split between my campaign and Serve America -- to help me hit my fundraising goal, win in Georgia, and defend our Democratic Senate majority? Thank you so much for your support. Each and every dollar truly does make a difference.

clean_body: I love talking directly with Democrats like you -- about your hopes and dreams, the challenges you face, and what got you in this fight. | | I love talking directly with Democrats like you, Derek -- about your hopes and dreams, the challenges you face, and what got you in this fight. So you can imagine how excited I am about the Democratic National Committee connecting me with supporters like you. If you chip in $7 today, you won’t just help elect Democrats up and down the ballot -- you could be one of the donors I call to personally thank for being a part of this incredible team. I’d love to get the chance to talk with you, Derek. Chip in $7 -- or whatever you can -- to the DNC today. We’ve got to keep electing Democrats at every level in the months and years ahead who are committed to making progress, and the DNC’s work is crucial to that goal. The DNC is making historic investments in state parties, on-the-ground organizing, and protecting the right to vote ahead of November’s midterm elections. Truth be told, none of it will be possible without your support. I couldn’t be more grateful to have you on our team. Hopefully we’ll get to talk more soon -- it’d be the highlight of my week. name: Eric Sorensen (personal)
subject: Checking in with Peter
body:
Hey there, Peter. I hope you're enjoying your morning.

**Election Day is exactly one month away.**

This weekend, our team of staff and volunteers are working extremely hard -- going door to door to make sure our supporters have all the information they need to submit their votes.

Among those we meet who are paying close attention to this race, one thing that always comes up is just how stark the contrast is between me and my opponent Esther King. This is a fairly moderate district, but that hasn't stopped King from touting some pretty extreme positions. She's anti-choice -- not to mention she's funded by the oil and gas industry.

I've sworn off fossil fuel contributions, and I wholeheartedly support reproductive freedom for all Americans. These are broadly popular positions, and as we head into the final month, we need to continue making our case -- _because it’s a winning one!_

Here's how your donations can still make a big impact:
* Funding postage and mailers to get our message to undecided voters
* Keeping our TV ads on the air to counter the ugly and unfounded attacks against us
* Feeding volunteers and paying for gas to help our team knock doors across IL-17

If you can, please send in a donation of $5 to power us through this final month before Election Day. Your contributions are more urgent now than at any other point in the campaign, so we hope you can chip in to help us prevail on November 8th.

| | Peter, The establishment and political class have failed America.
They've failed Arizona. They are only concerned about their OWN power, so they refuse to address the real problems we face. That's why the problems just get worse. We're seeing that now with the border crisis, rising inflation, failing schools, and growing distrust in every American institution. Those on the inside can't fix what's broken. They ARE what's broken. That's why we need an outsider NOW who can get things done.** ** **[I AGREE >>](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61557438:6ya8leV8N:m:1:3331421248:7A5E0DC9D2E3B119ECB8316D709AADD9:r)** _Just think about it ... Ronald Reagan didn't have political experience or government experience. President Donald Trump didn't either. We had great policies from these people._ I intend to bring policies to Arizona that are EQUALLY as great. I'm not coming into this game as a politician with a ruling class attitude. I'm taking on our real issues as a proud mom and as an American who is horrified by the action - and inaction - we're seeing in our government.
I think we're ready for another outsider to bring greatness to the people.**__** **_[Are you with me?](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61557438:6ya8leV8N:m:1:3331421248:7A5E0DC9D2E3B119ECB8316D709AADD9:r) _**
---
[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61557438:6ya8leV8N:m:1:3331421248:7A5E0DC9D2E3B119ECB8316D709AADD9:r)
---
[**I 'M WITH KARI: SECURE THE BORDER >>**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61557438:6ya8leV8N:m:1:3331421248:7A5E0DC9D2E3B119ECB8316D709AADD9:r)
---
**Peter, I promise you this, as the governor of Arizona, I will be the biggest pain in the ass Joe Biden 's ever experienced. ** I will unite with conservatives across the country to protect Arizona from this out-of-control federal government. We will save our states and return the power to WE, THE PEOPLE, where it belongs. **_This is our moment to make it happen. _**
---
Make no mistake... My opponent would be a NIGHTMARE to the pro-freedom, pro-America agenda we want to implement. Here's what you should know about Katie Hobbs. -> **_SHE WILL NOT DEFEND YOUR RIGHT TO BEAR ARMS!_** Katie has an F grade when it comes to protecting our Second Amendment rights. I don't know about you, but I feel that our Second Amendment is the most important amendment right now. _It 's the reason that we are still free. _ **_-> HER VOTING RECORD IS SHOCKING! _**She'll never talk about it, but 90% of the time when she was in our state legislature, she voted against small businesses. 90 percent! **_-> SHE FAILED TO SECURE OUR ELECTIONS._** Hobbs served as Secretary of State in 2020 in one of the most corrupt elections in American history. **_-> SHE IS A CONVICTED RACIST! _**Two separate juries unanimously convicted her of racial discrimination, and the taxpayers of Arizona are paying for her crimes! Almost $3 million as a payout for her court settlement because she did not pay Black employees the same as she paid white employees. _That is disgusting._
We cannot afford to let a radical lefty like Katie Hobbs turn Arizona into another California.**__**[**Will you help me defeat her?**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61557438:6ya8leV8N:m:1:3331421248:7A5E0DC9D2E3B119ECB8316D709AADD9:r)
---
Now, I don't care if you're with the Democrat Party, the Independent Party, the Republican Party, the Pizza Party, or the Pool Party - our policies are going to help every American. **_[We have to stand together and defeat the left so we can save America](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61557438:6ya8leV8N:m:1:3331421248:7A5E0DC9D2E3B119ECB8316D709AADD9:r)_. ** I hope that you will chip in now to support my campaign for Governor of Arizona.**__**
---

_Democrat Eric Swalwell represents California's 14th Congressional District. _
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52229638/371641926/979766792?refcode=E17393-20221001-headerfooter-header-Other-RegTemplate-NA-NA&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDMvMS85MDcyNyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiOTcyZjczOS0zODQ3LWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgyNThkMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=mOTT6ISfVJkmyl5J0CVWlL_ySt70z_smrL7YLH_nbAs=)
I’m so grateful that Representative Swalwell said I could reach out to you – because we both urgently need your help.

**I defied the odds to defeat Sarah Palin in Alaska’s special election for Congress. I'm the first Alaska Native to represent Alaska in DC. And I’m the only Democrat to represent Alaska in the House in decades.**

Friends,

We got completely blindsided...this is not ideal.

subject: Hollywood = Satanic Values
body:
[](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=73e72adde43f4f578069a9d7bb4f086e&_e=2dtylz8_IHXF4fime2vQNa79jxFnxhS9fYo7GXssvSQsM2HON4LA-7l8zOkWoLa2VwnQhzYAowelaIM0Ti41YBnREA_-L5uWqUE2Dl9YxDO4sjVGnUBzKXYuJ0jTQgLPGWwbYrzTJhm4EzRJcA0J7uiv3N3lWhNmLdmpFqXnust3avJp0PTV3R2YrJzmNbkstNczXhLF16zh618x-ffro7AbZu0Q4BE9OjIVrzkrth6kPTWyTynXtswJ4Zgyf_CW6ZZLjd2ekwxzSOiSjzqWVdEFBLhdYKgZgQThBa5DS14%3D)
Friend,

Would you believe me if I said that a mother watched videos of her daughter having sex with her boyfriend and picked which one her daughter looked best in to **sell?**

Because that’s exactly what happened — Kris Jenner watched AND hand-picked which sex tape her daughter Kim Kardashian would release!

**It is not an exaggeration to say that Hollywood is satanic.**
What could possibly be more satanic than a mother using her daughter's body to sell sex?

If that disgusts you, here’s where it gets worse. _It worked_. Kim Kardashian is a billionaire, and she’s still selling sex.

She is symbolic of the society we live in today. That if you are willing to degrade yourself, if you’re willing to denigrate yourself, then our society will give you more.

**Is this the example we want to leave for our children?**

At BLEXIT, we believe families should be grounded in faith and honor and respect their children and protect their innocence.

My name is Candace Owens, co-founder of the BLEXIT Foundation. BLEXIT focuses on educating minorities about the history of our great country, the principles of the Constitution, and the importance of self-reliance.

I’ve set a goal to raise $50,000 by the end of the month to show the next generation that they don’t have to be like the Kardashians to be successful.

[**Can you support this critical mission with a gift of $10, $25, or even $50? Click here to donate today >>>**](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=73e72adde43f4f578069a9d7bb4f086e&_e=2dtylz8_IHXF4fime2vQNa79jxFnxhS9fYo7GXssvSQsM2HON4LA-7l8zOkWoLa2VwnQhzYAowelaIM0Ti41YBnREA_-L5uWqUE2Dl9YxDO4sjVGnUBzKXYuJ0jTQgLPGWwbYrzTJhm4EzRJcA0J7jE80RrolaxRkEFDUYAZ82aWC2SKotdY6ZfDxUL__d03kwDlW-ZUwEg5McsDWilufDlP_XvDOT1x6z7kiuro3NrMyEslMwVO62I5PtYkj326kZHooetNAxQGXoglXbekoDAU-01_1Vun2RIUGVN_YbU%3D)

BLEXIT is bringing pro-America, pro-Family values to Black and minority communities through the work of our State Chapters.

Our Chapters spread the universal principles of the BLEXIT movement at the local level through community service, social engagement, educational activities, and virtual events.

They demonstrate how people can escape the mentality of victimhood and empower others to take control of their destinies.

Just this summer, **BLEXIT-Fest in New Jersey introduced our message to over 400 people.** They had a variety of talented performers and speakers and created a memorable community celebration.

**BLEXIT chapter members from our Tampa, FL, and North Charleston, SC sites educated and cared for approximately 80 children** for six weeks during our full-day Summer Camp.

The children in our Tampa program even took a field trip to Legoland!

Now that school has started, these BLEXIT chapters are providing an after-school youth education program – Liberation Camp – for 80 children.

_BLEXIT’s Chapters are a huge part of our Back to School initiative_.

The BLEXIT Illinois Chapter **distributed over 400 school supplies** and BLEXIT merchandise in one of Chicago’s most impoverished communities. The NY Chapter was fortunate to **give away 120 school supply kits as well as 40 book bags.**

BLEXIT Chapters are changing the narrative that surrounds America’s minority communities.

[**We currently have 42 chapters across the US and more than 14,000 volunteers! You can help BLEXIT support our State Chapters by donating $10, $25, $50, or any other amount today. Click here to send your gift >>>**](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=73e72adde43f4f578069a9d7bb4f086e&_e=2dtylz8_IHXF4fime2vQNa79jxFnxhS9fYo7GXssvSQsM2HON4LA-7l8zOkWoLa2VwnQhzYAowelaIM0Ti41YBnREA_-L5uWqUE2Dl9YxDO4sjVGnUBzKXYuJ0jTQgLPGWwbYrzTJhm4EzRJcA0J7shPkOt7zaYdW4IaUb50X6J9TUqGFK78cLp4LS4Ko2KhV-IsVXydkZdP4DDDSVlYqZ3gebqcC0K8AcqDlxY0M_e9aHPF1Q4Kkvxto0CFVvGXDLe_H6ElcI9PZcQI0fWbYs2mvkudJwT8WFiDB9bidyQ%3D)

BLEXIT is the Black exit from the culture of victimhood, fear, and dependence reinforced by groups that market themselves as serving the Black community, such as Black Lives Matter, but in actuality, they destroy communities.

These organizations are poisoning minority communities. They tell these bright young men and women they are victims of systematic repression and that their skin color is all that defines them.

But here’s the ugly truth about other organizations who claim to serve the Black community:

* They claim to support Black communities. . . but they fan the flames of riots and violence that directly impact the lives of the people in those communities.

* They claim to fight for criminal justice reform. . . but they teach Black men and women to hate and disrespect police officers.

* They claim to be a non-profit group fighting for Black men and women. . . but they use donor funds to enrich themselves.

**These other organizations are destroying Black communities, dividing our country, and forcing a message of victimhood and hatred down the throats of minorities.**

BLEXIT is countering their hateful narrative, but we can’t do it alone, Friend. Can you donate to BLEXIT today and help us reach our goal of raising $50,000?

clean_body: Friend, Would you believe me if I said that a mother watched videos of her daughter having sex with her boyfriend and picked which one her daughter looked best in to sell? Because that’s exactly what happened — Kris Jenner watched AND hand-picked which sex tape her daughter Kim Kardashian would release! It is not an exaggeration to say that Hollywood is satanic. What could possibly be more satanic than a mother using her daughter's body to sell sex? If that disgusts you, here’s where it gets worse. It worked. Kim Kardashian is a billionaire, and she’s still selling sex. She is symbolic of the society we live in today. That if you are willing to degrade yourself, if you’re willing to denigrate yourself, then our society will give you more. Is this the example we want to leave for our children? At BLEXIT, we believe families should be grounded in faith and honor and respect their children and protect their innocence. My name is Candace Owens, co-founder of the BLEXIT Foundation. BLEXIT focuses on educating minorities about the history of our great country, the principles of the Constitution, and the importance of self-reliance. I’ve set a goal to raise $50,000 by the end of the month to show the next generation that they don’t have to be like the Kardashians to be successful. BLEXIT is bringing pro-America, pro-Family values to Black and minority communities through the work of our State Chapters. Our Chapters spread the universal principles of the BLEXIT movement at the local level through community service, social engagement, educational activities, and virtual events. They demonstrate how people can escape the mentality of victimhood and empower others to take control of their destinies. Just this summer, BLEXIT-Fest in New Jersey introduced our message to over 400 people. They had a variety of talented performers and speakers and created a memorable community celebration. BLEXIT chapter members from our Tampa, FL, and North Charleston, SC sites educated and cared for approximately 80 children for six weeks during our full-day Summer Camp. The children in our Tampa program even took a field trip to Legoland! Now that school has started, these BLEXIT chapters are providing an after-school youth education program – Liberation Camp – for 80 children. BLEXIT’s Chapters are a huge part of our Back to School initiative. The BLEXIT Illinois Chapter distributed over 400 school supplies and BLEXIT merchandise in one of Chicago’s most impoverished communities. The NY Chapter was fortunate to give away 120 school supply kits as well as 40 book bags. BLEXIT Chapters are changing the narrative that surrounds America’s minority communities. BLEXIT is the Black exit from the culture of victimhood, fear, and dependence reinforced by groups that market themselves as serving the Black community, such as Black Lives Matter, but in actuality, they destroy communities. These organizations are poisoning minority communities. They tell these bright young men and women they are victims of systematic repression and that their skin color is all that defines them. But here’s the ugly truth about other organizations who claim to serve the Black community: They claim to support Black communities. . . but they fan the flames of riots and violence that directly impact the lives of the people in those communities. They claim to fight for criminal justice reform. . . but they teach Black men and women to hate and disrespect police officers. They claim to be a non-profit group fighting for Black men and women. . . but they use donor funds to enrich themselves. These other organizations are destroying Black communities, dividing our country, and forcing a message of victimhood and hatred down the throats of minorities.** BLEXIT is countering their hateful narrative, but we can’t do it alone, Friend. Can you donate to BLEXIT today and help us reach our goal of raising $50,000? Thank you, Candace Owens Co-Founder & President BLEXIT Foundation BLEXIT is a 501(c)3 tax-exempt organization. All contributions are tax-deductible to the extent provided by law. Sent to Conservatives Give subscribers. 625 First Street #183, Alexandria, VA 22314

31 days to go
#
It’s official, Peter,
We’re one month out from Election Day and the stakes are higher than ever.

Fellow American,

When I decided to run for office, I knew I would be attacked. Unfortunately, that's politics these days.

I knew the Left would try to paint me as a man unfit to serve in public office. After all, I struggled with mental health issues when my professional football career ended. But I sought treatment, got help, and then spent the next decade encouraging others to get help if they needed it. In fact, I even wrote a book about my journey, _Breaking Free: My Life with Dissociated Identity Disorder_ , with the goal of helping others.

This summer, Raphael Warnock and Chuck Schumer's Super PAC spent more than $50 million attacking my character, my family, and my mental health struggles.

**But their ads didn't work.** The personal attacks against me failed to move the needle, so Raphael Warnock and I are neck-and-neck in the polls in the Georgia Senate race.

In their desperation to find something to distract the voters from real issues and blunt our momentum, they came up with an "October Surprise" alleging that I paid for a woman to have an abortion.

**Let me be clear: I have never paid for anyone to have an abortion. It's a flat-out lie.**

We cannot let the Left win by lying, cheating, or buying their way to victory. We need to stand together to fight back with the truth.

**[Fellow American, today I need your assistance more than ever before in this campaign. I need the resources to talk directly to the voters and clear the record.](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=3dd5cb6ebbbe45e98001a0f7c739b69b&_e=DhDmi5UQQRUneaXLjshAI8q9jWieyplC-MbyMWGcQX_d6t2fgvBC0dBgJYPXIAcFUPGX8oN83ePPTdq7D5kh0iVlJaZEOEtpJcNywMFEqXd1vUVDFiHxBqN67d3FDWNLUYQbngBqTyPH_DBWSUJIaLrDKTxLN2mA4l1QxqQ_cPgBl1toAIUbPO-xRCwsTa6ENbXDBBY4xzNL8Ea4GQYcHXeTF603un1S2UFuvVD_pdZqjbhXFASFFnPYcReJz0rZqNT9_Swq48niZFBHIj3ZVzfE4mlR3_uK2Bjv5GPmVY17u9pmrlN9ul-ZKDS8Y9yD1XW0yAv9QUgevoXGfA4n30S9W4cy5OveJ1TYxw83lWvZ0kIVcrhvJXJ7PwR4N9pTme_2piIETKgj3N71oDK0Dw%3D%3D) **

Undecided voters are watching this race closely, and the Left knows it. That's why, 35 days before the election, they decided to distract from the real issues by telling a lie about me.

First, the Left used these tactics against Justice Clarence Thomas in an unsuccessful effort to keep him off the Supreme Court.

Then, 27 years later, they did the same thing to Justice Brett Kavanaugh as they tried to destroy him, his reputation, and his family.

Their intimidation tactics didn't work on Justices Thomas or Kavanaugh, and they're not going to work on me. Right now, all they've done is energize me more.

**The Left is desperate to win this Senate race because they want to change this country, but we're not going to let it happen.**

clean_body: The scandal is not in their actions, but in their absolute hypocrisy. | | | By now, you’ve probably seen the most recent scandal surrounding Herschel Walker, the Republican candidate for U.S. Senate in Georgia: But let’s be clear, Peter: This story is not about Walker’s actions,but about his hypocrisy — and the hypocrisy of the entire Republican Party on the issue of abortion. When he was asked this week about reports that he paid for his girlfriend’s abortion, here’s how he responded: “If that had happened, I would have said there's nothing to be ashamed of there.” He’s right. There’s nothing shameful in seeking abortion care. What is shameful is how Republicans are proposing a national abortion ban for everyone else — and are counting on votes from Herschel Walker, Ron Johnson, and Dr. Oz in the Senate to make it happen. We just have a month left to remind voters that abortion should be accessible to everyone, not just the privileged few — and to elect champions who will make that vision a reality. Republicans believe they can play by two sets of rules, Peter. Herschel Walker is not the first GOP candidate who sought abortion care, while publicly calling for other people seeking care and doctors to be prosecuted or worse. When these Republicans talk about banning abortion, we know what they’re really after — controlling people’s bodies. They are saying so out loud. | | Friend, As Chairman of the Kendall County Board, I have made it a priority to keep taxes in check while providing top-notch services. This common-sense approach has kept law enforcement funded and made Kendall County one of the best places to live, work, and raise a family in the country. Unfortunately, Congress has a different view. Currently in Washington, they see common-sense leadership as the problem. I see it as the solution. Higher inflation, higher gas prices, and higher energy bills have hit Illinois families hard. Unfortunately, Lauren Underwood continually pushed the Green New Deal and costly tax hikes at the expense of hardworking Americans. I believe we deserve better. We need a Congressperson who is looking to cut taxes, not hike them; to lower energy bills, not raise them. I will stop the "consumer last" mentality and bring the lower taxes, better government approach I have taken in Kendall County to Congress. But I need your help to get there! | | | __**[You may not know me, so let me share my story.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61559553:6iAiVeVXN:m:1:3317145305:26564E5E6E9CA62CBEE9741252E7EBC1:r "You may not know me, so let me share my story.")**__
My name's Tiffany Smiley. I'm a mom of three, veteran's wife, and Republican candidate for U.S. Senate in Washington.

I'm running against a 30-year Democrat incumbent to bring **real change** to our country.

I married my high school sweetheart, Scotty, who was permanently blinded by a suicide bomber while serving in Iraq.

From there, I took on the federal government to fight for the rights that Scotty _**earned**_ as an active duty service member, and I _**won**_.

Fighting for Scotty inspired me to **advocate for _all_ veterans**, so I went to D.C. to speak up for those who put their lives on the line for our country.

Now, I need _your_ help to send me to D.C. to advocate for Washingtonians and all Americans who have been hurt by the terrible policies of Joe Biden and my Democrat opponent Patty Murray.

---
| | [HELP TIFFANY'S CAMPAIGN](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61559553:6iAiVeVXN:m:1:3317145305:26564E5E6E9CA62CBEE9741252E7EBC1:r "HELP TIFFANY’S CAMPAIGN")
---

Murray has been in office for _**three decades**_ and has done **nothing** to stop the rising crime, homelessness, and drug addiction crisis tearing my beloved home state apart.

I'm running for U.S. Senate because Americans deserve better than the failed leadership they've been stuck with for _years_.

It's time for a _**change**_ in D.C., and I'm the right person for the job.

The latest polls in Washington show that my opponent and I will be _**neck and neck**_ , and I'm getting nervous. We're _finally_ closing in on Murray, but I need your support to cross the finish line.

_**[Can you chip in any amount to help me take the lead to save Washington?](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61559553:6iAiVeVXN:m:1:3317145305:26564E5E6E9CA62CBEE9741252E7EBC1:r "Can you chip in any amount to help
me take the lead to save Washington? ")**_

Your support will bring me closer to restoring the American dream from the U.S. Senate.

---

To victory,

Tiffany Smiley

The Washington Senate race is now the #1 battleground race in the COUNTRY!

_**[Rush support now to be a part of history](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61559554:6iAiVeVXN:m:1:3317145305:26564E5E6E9CA62CBEE9741252E7EBC1:r "Rush support now to be a part of history")**_.

Tiffany Smiley

Tiffany is a veterans' advocate and mother of 3! She is the new, fresh leadership we desperately need in Washington! Tiffany will be your #1 supporter in the U.S. Senate.

We're out of time. There's nowhere else to turn. Tiffany needs us at this moment. _**[Step up now!](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61559556:6iAiVeVXN:m:1:3317145305:26564E5E6E9CA62CBEE9741252E7EBC1:r "Step up now!")**_

Friend,
Before I ask you to make a contribution to Mandela Barnes' campaign for U.S. Senate in Wisconsin, I would like to take a moment to say why it's so important that we help him defeat Ron Johnson and expand the Senate majority.

Let me be very clear:

Ron Johnson is a self-serving multimillionaire who voted to give huge tax breaks to himself and his billionaire donors. How pathetic is that?

Mandela Barnes can defeat him – but only if we're all in this together.

The latest Marquette poll shows Mandela trailing Ron Johnson by 1 point, and Mandela is currently up against millions of dollars in ugly right-wing super PAC ads. Now more than ever, he needs your help to regain the momentum in this race.

So before tonight's fundraising deadline, Mandela needs a lot of donations to show there is strong grassroots support for his campaign. That's why I am asking:
**[Can you split a $15 contribution between Mandela Barnes' campaign for U.S. Senate in Wisconsin and American Bridge PAC before tonight's fundraising deadline? Mandela Barnes is building that kind of movement through his campaign for U.S. Senate in Wisconsin. He is bringing together a multiracial, multigenerational movement of people who understand that the billionaire class cannot have it all. At a time of obscene levels of income and wealth inequality, we must address the needs of working families in this country.

As the son of a public school teacher and General Motors worker, Mandela knows the struggles of the working class. And if we can elect him to the Senate, he will take on the billionaire class and large corporations that control a large part of the economy and exert enormous influence over our political system.

But the only way Mandela will run a successful campaign is if lots of people come together and get involved in the Wisconsin Senate race.

While Ron Johnson collects big checks from his special interest donors and corporate PACs, Mandela is counting on lots of people giving small donations before tonight's deadline.

Your contribution will ensure Mandela has the financial resources to flip Wisconsin's Senate seat. So I am asking you one more time:
**[Can you split a $15 contribution between Mandela Barnes and American Bridge PAC before the fundraising deadline? Thank you for adding your contribution to his campaign before tonight's deadline.
