body:
[ https://act.timforoh.com/go/46?t=1001&akid=5998%2E3611125%2E0UyP0n ][IMG]

Howdy, folks! It’s Tim, reporting live from another FULL day out
on the trail.

Today, our Workers First Express has us in Cleveland, where we’re knocking
doors and talking to voters 1 MONTH before one of the most consequential
elections Ohio has ever seen.

Seriously, that’s how important Ohio’s Senate race is—and it’s why I need
your help to make sure we can keep going and reach as many voters as
possible over these final 31 days.

[ https://act.timforoh.com/go/25272?t=1008&amount=25&akid=5998%2E3611125%2E0UyP0n ]So, before I tell you what I’m hearing from folks on the trail, would
it be too much to ask for you to chip in $10 or even $25 to help us win
the race that’ll decide Senate control?

[ https://act.timforoh.com/go/25272?t=1009&amount=25&akid=5998%2E3611125%2E0UyP0n ]Donate

Just this week, I’ve talked to hundreds, if not thousands, of Ohio voters.

Sure, every conversation is different. Some folks are terrified of what
may happen if we don’t protect abortion rights ASAP. Others are fighting
for affordable health care, and there are plenty more who are simply
trying to put food on the table and gas in their tanks.

will go to Washington, roll up their sleeves, and fight for their families

name: Tiffany Smiley
subject: My story in pictures
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Smiley for Washington, Inc
body:
| |
---
| | | Patriot,

My name is Tiffany Smiley and I wanted to tell you a little bit about myself and why I'm running for the U.S. Senate in Washington.

I grew up in Pasco, Washington where I helped out on my family's farm and learned the value of hard work.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61551468:JPK8IeVLN:m:1:3299561967:7DF5DD965067AFC9D5109F4702CC91CA:r "I helped out on my family’s farm and learned the value of
hard work.")
---

I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College, where I also studied to become a nurse so I could pursue my passion of helping others in need.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61551468:JPK8IeVLN:m:1:3299561967:7DF5DD965067AFC9D5109F4702CC91CA:r "I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College")
---

I married my high school sweetheart Scotty, who went on to serve our country in the United States Army while I started my nursing career.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61551468:JPK8IeVLN:m:1:3299561967:7DF5DD965067AFC9D5109F4702CC91CA:r "I married my high school sweetheart Scotty")
---

In 2005, I received a call that changed both our lives forever, Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq, causing him to fall into a coma and permanently lose sight in both of his eyes.

I immediately booked a flight for Walter Reed Medical Center to be by Scotty's side.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61551468:JPK8IeVLN:m:1:3299561967:7DF5DD965067AFC9D5109F4702CC91CA:r "Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq")
---

When I arrived, Scotty was still in trauma care, and I was informed that he would never be able to serve his nation again in uniform. They even asked me to sign a document, right there on the spot, consenting to Scotty's immediate discharge from the Army.
_**I refused. **_
Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61551468:JPK8IeVLN:m:1:3299561967:7DF5DD965067AFC9D5109F4702CC91CA:r "Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and
every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.")
---

Scotty went on to serve as America's first blind active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61551468:JPK8IeVLN:m:1:3299561967:7DF5DD965067AFC9D5109F4702CC91CA:r "Scotty went on to serve as America’s first blind
active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way. ")
---

It's not every day you hear about American women going up against the U.S. Military. But we defied the government in a big way--_and won._

We stood up to a broken bureaucracy because it was the right thing to do. I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61551468:JPK8IeVLN:m:1:3299561967:7DF5DD965067AFC9D5109F4702CC91CA:r "I will always
stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.")
---

In 2007, we welcomed our first child. While Scotty will never be able to 'see' our children's faces, he's always been an incredible father and hero to our boys.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61551468:JPK8IeVLN:m:1:3299561967:7DF5DD965067AFC9D5109F4702CC91CA:r "In 2007, we welcomed our first child.")
---

Now, our family is taking on a new challenge. I'm running for US Senate to help families across the country achieve the American Dream and save our country from Joe Biden and Patty Murray.

I will take the same fight and optimistic spirit I've shown throughout my life to help Washington families secure a better life. I believe that now, more than ever, Washingtonians need a voice to find solutions to their unique problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61551468:JPK8IeVLN:m:1:3299561967:7DF5DD965067AFC9D5109F4702CC91CA:r "Washingtonians
need a voice to find solutions to their unique problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress.")
---

My family began this journey in the halls of Walter Reed and we look forward to continuing this journey in the halls of the United States Capitol.

I would love for the next photo in this story to be us winning this race with my family by my side.

We can't do that, however, without your help, friend. _**[So please, can you chip in just a few bucks to help us keep up the momentum we've achieved so far.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61551468:JPK8IeVLN:m:1:3299561967:7DF5DD965067AFC9D5109F4702CC91CA:r "So please, can you chip in just a
few bucks to help us keep up the momentum we’ve achieved so far. ")**_

---
| | | [KEEP TIFFANY IN THE FIGHT](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61551468:JPK8IeVLN:m:1:3299561967:7DF5DD965067AFC9D5109F4702CC91CA:r "KEEP
TIFFANY IN THE FIGHT")
---
| | | [STAND UP FOR AMERICA](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61551468:JPK8IeVLN:m:1:3299561967:7DF5DD965067AFC9D5109F4702CC91CA:r "STAND UP FOR AMERICA")
---

I know with your support we can win this.

Sincerely,

Tiffany Smiley

---
| |

---
* * *
---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61551469:JPK8IeVLN:m:1:3299561967:7DF5DD965067AFC9D5109F4702CC91CA:r "All
Eyes On Washington")
---
Hey, it's Tiffany Smiley.

The Washington Senate race is now the #1 battleground race in the COUNTRY!

Needless to say, all eyes are on us. We are in the FINAL DAYS until the November election, and Patty Murray is flooding millions into our state.

We are in an uphill battle, and I can't make it up to the top without you. Not just Washingtonians, but all Americans deserve a real leader with real solutions. Together, we can ensure that the American Dream is not lost.

_**[Rush support now to be a part of history](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61551469:JPK8IeVLN:m:1:3299561967:7DF5DD965067AFC9D5109F4702CC91CA:r "Rush support now to be a part of
history")**_.

Let's raise money and WIN,

Tiffany Smiley

---
| | | [JOIN TEAM SMILEY](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61551469:JPK8IeVLN:m:1:3299561967:7DF5DD965067AFC9D5109F4702CC91CA:r "JOIN TEAM
SMILEY")
---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61551470:JPK8IeVLN:m:1:3299561967:7DF5DD965067AFC9D5109F4702CC91CA:r "Alert!")
---

Team Smiley here with a RED ALERT!

You know we don't often beg, plead, or panic, but Tiffany is facing a key deadline, and we're OUT of time.

Whether or not you choose to act will decide the outcome of the Washington U.S. Senate Election:

Tiffany is currently being outraised and outspent by her 30-year incumbent opponent. We need all hands on deck to turn things around TODAY.

There's no time to wait on the sidelines.

_**[That's why we're HUMBLY asking for your help in the next 15 minutes!](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61551471:JPK8IeVLN:m:1:3299561967:7DF5DD965067AFC9D5109F4702CC91CA:r "That's why we're HUMBLY asking for your help in the next 15 minutes!")**_

This is our only chance to make history and restore a brighter future for Washington and all of America. We need Tiffany Smiley in the U.S. Senate, plain and simple.

Our team doesn't want to have to deliver bad news to Tiffany later today, so we're calling on our grassroots team, including YOU, to help increase our momentum!

Tiffany is a veterans' advocate and mother of 3! She is the new, fresh leadership we desperately need in Washington! Tiffany will be your #1 supporter in the U.S. Senate.

We're out of time. There's nowhere else to turn. Tiffany needs us at this moment. _**[Step up now!](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61551471:JPK8IeVLN:m:1:3299561967:7DF5DD965067AFC9D5109F4702CC91CA:r "Step up now!")**_

---

Mitch McConnell and his super PAC just launched a new $26 MILLION blitz of attack ads against me when Trump announced his rally. **We will lose our Senate majority if my campaign continues to be outspent and drowned out on the airwaves by Trump and McConnell.**
[**Please, split a donation of $5 between my campaign and Alex Padilla right now. Fellow American,

Making the most of these final days will take historic amounts of people power and, frankly, money. | | One month. That’s all the time we have left to persuade voters to vote for Democrats, mobilize voters to cast their ballots, and set our party up for a successful Election Day. Now, a lot of folks are going to reach out and remind you of everything we could lose if we fall short this year. But today, in these final 31 days, here’s what we have to gain if we defend and expand our congressional majorities. If we win this November, we can continue working to ban the sale of assault weapons and keep communities safer. If we win this November, we can codify the freedom to choose into federal law. If we win this November, we can defend the cornerstone of our democracy: the freedom to vote. On November 9, the day after Election Day, we don’t want to wake up wishing we did more. The future of our country is being written right now, Derek. In some states, voters are already casting their ballots -- we need to fight like hell today. Hi, Peter, it's John, Trudy's husband (aka the luckiest man in the world). I want to take a moment today to tell you about the first time I met Trudy. This story is really special to me – honestly, I'm already getting choked up just writing this email.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52239259/371659303/-1746441832?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk323-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzQ4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkMjZiYzFlOC00YzQ3LWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgyNThkMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=AUjJQHRuAIYk07g7qXiCrO8LutsnM8ldf3OS7dL6WE8=)
Both Trudy and I have lost spouses to cancer. The year after my wife died felt impossible for a million reasons – no one tells you just how isolating grief is. When folks asked me how I was doing, more often than not I found myself fibbing. I learned quickly that most people who asked that question weren't equipped to handle the messy but honest answer.
I first met Trudy about a year after my wife died. She'd heard that my wife passed, and like so many other people, she asked how I was doing. But when Trudy asked that question, it felt entirely different. I could tell within minutes of meeting her that she truly cared about how I felt. She didn't want a shallow, empty answer. **Trudy wanted to actually know how I was doing – and she wanted to help me shoulder some of my grief.** We had a nearly instantaneous connection.
I learned during that first meeting just how big Trudy's heart is. And as I got to know her better, I watched her go through life wearing that big, open heart right on her sleeve. **As a parent, a nurse, and now a candidate for Senate, Trudy leads with empathy, warmth, and genuine compassion for everyone she meets.**
On the campaign trail, Trudy doesn't give people a listening ear just for show; she truly sees folks for who they are – and she won't let anyone get away with a shallow answer to a big, important question. Just like she was trained to do as a nurse, Trudy hunts for the symptoms and then works tirelessly to find the right course of treatment. **That's the type of leader that Washington needs right now.**

subject: You can't be trusted..
body:
| | | Peter, Imagine that you've just been called into the middle school principal's office to have a "serious talk" about your daughter. You're worried -- is it her grades? Her behavior? Is she hurt? Instead, the principal tells you that your daughter -- your 12- year-old little girl -- is now your son. That behind your back, the school has been "educating" your preteen daughter \-- for months, in total secret -- about how to "transition" her gender. And they instructed her to keep it hidden from you...because you "can't be trusted." That you, her parent, are not "safe." But now, she has a new name. New pronouns. A new bathroom. And you just need to accept it. _Wouldn 't you be furious?_ I know I would be! So it's no surprise that's exactly how Jessica Konen felt when she was called into her daughter's California middle school and this nightmare played out in real life. **Now, Jessica is fighting back and suing the school district -- plus the principal and the two teachers who "groomed" her daughter -- and she needs your help to win justice in a court of law. ** [**Will you please make an urgent, tax-deductible donation to the Center for American Liberty and help us fund this lawsuit while generating a nationwide wave of support for Jessica and her daughter?**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61559647:JNsdHeVON:m:1:3331421248:B0679650A6D2FBAC0F46A33E28F94D84:r) I hope you will, because as infuriating as that story is, the details are even more outrageous. Would you believe Jessica's daughter was just eleven when she was lured by these teachers to join their so-called "Equality Club"? **_They first convinced this little girl that she was bisexual. Then, as they sunk their hooks deeper, they told her -- not long after her twelfth birthday -- that really, she was probably "transgender." _** "But don't tell your parents!" they warned. In fact, they operated the entire club under a cloak of secrecy. No permission slips were signed. No attendance was taken. No membership lists were kept. Meetings were scheduled for lunchtime -- instead of after school, like other clubs -- so parents wouldn't begin to wonder where their kids were. What were they hiding?? If you've followed the growing nationwide problem of teachers "grooming" young, confused students -- you probably know some of the predatory tactics these teachers often use to manipulate vulnerable children into believing they're "transgender" or "non-binary." This case was no exception. In fact, these two teachers even let some of their secrets slip on leaked audio from a Teachers Association conference! Discussing how they managed to target so many new recruits for their club, one of the teachers confessed: "We totally stalked what they were doing on Google." **These teachers zeroed in on confused and troubled students and -- instead of helping them -- they further filled these children 's heads with lies and more confusion. ** [**Which is why I 'm asking you to make an urgent donation of $35 or more today if you agree with our lawsuit against these teachers, the principal, and the Spreckels Union School District.**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61559647:JNsdHeVON:m:1:3331421248:B0679650A6D2FBAC0F46A33E28F94D84:r) My name is Harmeet Dhillon. I'm a lawyer, and the founder of the Center for American Liberty. You may recognize me from one of my many Fox News appearances with Jessica Konen or other plaintiffs my nonprofit organization is representing in lawsuits against government officials who violate Americans' rights. Today, I'm asking you to join us in support of Jessica's case. It's clear that the defendants deprived Jessica Konen of her civil rights as a parent, that they conspired to do so, and that they inflicted emotional distress on both Jessica and her daughter. Those legal claims and more are at the heart of our lawsuit. I believe our evidence lays out a very strong case. But you must remember, this is a California school district and the defense's case will be funded by the government. And it will pay whatever it takes to defend leftist ideologies. [**That 's why, I hope you'll also consider making a generous donation of $25, $35, $50 or $100 to help fund our case. **](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61559647:JNsdHeVON:m:1:3331421248:B0679650A6D2FBAC0F46A33E28F94D84:r) The Center for American Liberty is a nonprofit organization, meaning we receive no government funding -- _unlike the deep-pocketed defendants in most of our cases._ Because of this, we rely on support from generous Americans who can recognize an injustice and want to see it set right. Our nonprofit status also means your donation is tax-deductible to the fullest extent allowed by law. We've seen evidence of this type of "grooming" at schools across the country. And it's not just in places like California! Dangerous teachers like this are unfortunately in classrooms across the country. Thankfully, the tide seems to be turning against them. Earlier this year, Governor DeSantis outlawed teachers from having these sexualized conversations with their young students. And elsewhere, parents have gotten involved with their local school boards to run for office and change policies that have put radical gender ideology ahead of student safety or parental rights. Those are political solutions. **Ours is a legal one.** And I believe that, in order to fully purge this predatory behavior from our schools, we need to fight this battle on all available fronts. Won't you please help us win this fight in a court of law?**[Join the fight with a generous donation of $35 or more so the courts, the plaintiffs, the defendants -- everybody -- will know how big the nationwide movement to protect kids has grown. ](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61559647:JNsdHeVON:m:1:3331421248:B0679650A6D2FBAC0F46A33E28F94D84:r)** ** ** No parent should have to endure what Jessica Konen and her daughter did, and it's up to us to use the full force of the law to make sure no teacher is allowed to get away with this again. Thank you,

Winning this case will not only get justice for the Konen family, but also strike a blow against these dangerous school policies nationwide. **[Which is why I hope we can count on your generous tax-deductible donation of $25, $35, $50 or more to help us win this lawsuit and others like it. subject: October Surprise

body:
Anything that comes out of left field could ultimately decide who controls the Senate in November.
There’s a term in politics used to describe a last-minute momentum shift in the weeks leading up to a big election—something that can completely flip a race on its head.

It’s called an **October Surprise** , and since JD and I are basically tied, anything that comes out of left field could ultimately decide who controls the Senate in November.

_That’s why it’s absolutely critical that we kickstart October with a huge outpouring of grassroots support._

[**_Can I count on you to kick in $5 between my campaign and Shontel Brown's ASAP so we can stockpile resources and avoid any October pitfalls that might take the wind out of our sails? We have to raise $100,000 in the next week to keep our TV ads on the air._**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52240168/371663392/1918576256?refcode=EM_FR_221008OctoberSurprise_TRSplit_TR_ALL_8_NG_TESTA_l1&amount=5&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84Nzg0NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5ZGI0YjFlYi01NDQ3LWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgyNThkMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=FJssJLk8xlT05kn5hxnNf8rHhVCPOBcy5pQz6oXN9aE=) [DONATE TODAY](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52240169/371663393/1918576256?refcode=EM_FR_221008OctoberSurprise_TRSplit_TR_ALL_8_NG_TESTA_b1&amount=5&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84Nzg0NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5ZGI0YjFlYi01NDQ3LWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgyNThkMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=FJssJLk8xlT05kn5hxnNf8rHhVCPOBcy5pQz6oXN9aE=) This is one of the closest races in the country, Peter.

_Which means that anything and everything could have an outsized impact on the outcome of the race._

Hi, friend. It's Val Demings.
I don't get downtime that often, but when I do, my husband, Jerry, and I like to go through our old photo albums. We laugh at the horribly out-of-style outfits, get teary at how little our three sons once were and take a moment to acknowledge where we started versus where we are now.
Friend, only in America could our family have achieved this level of opportunity. I'm the Black daughter of a maid and a janitor who grew up in the 1960s South, and I have a real chance at becoming Florida’s next senator.

I owe a large part of my success to Jerry, who has been my partner in crime fighting for more than three decades – but I also owe immense gratitude to grassroots supporters like you.
Thanks to this massive grassroots team, we've been able to outraise Rubio _every single quarter _and make this race competitive _. _But we're in danger of falling short of our FINAL FEC quarterly fundraising goal – and we're running out of time to close the gap.

We need to elect more candidates up and down the ballot who will take on authoritarianism and bigotry, and who are prepared to fight for justice. In order to do that, we must bring our people together in a multi-generational, multi-racial movement.
Mandela Barnes is building that kind of movement through his campaign in Wisconsin. And if he wins in November, he will continue our struggle for justice in the U.S. Senate.
First, we need to come together to defeat a Republican extremist who denies the reality of climate change, participated in a scheme to overturn the 2020 election results and has repeatedly sided with corporate interests at the expense of working people.
But this Wisconsin Senate race isn't just about replacing Ron Johnson. It's also about expanding the Senate majority and building Democratic power at the state level so we can finally have the votes to pass meaningful legislation to address the many crises we face.

My name's Tiffany Smiley. I'm a mom of three, veteran's wife, and Republican candidate for U.S. Senate in Washington.

I'm running against a 30-year Democrat incumbent to bring **real change** to our country.

I married my high school sweetheart, Scotty, who was permanently blinded by a suicide bomber while serving in Iraq.

From there, I took on the federal government to fight for the rights that Scotty _**earned**_ as an active duty service member, and I _**won**_.

Fighting for Scotty inspired me to **advocate for _all_ veterans**, so I went to D.C. to speak up for those who put their lives on the line for our country.

Now, I need _your_ help to send me to D.C. to advocate for Washingtonians and all Americans who have been hurt by the terrible policies of Joe Biden and my Democrat opponent Patty Murray.

---
| | [HELP TIFFANY'S CAMPAIGN](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61559689:JCPtieVNc:m:1:3331421248:772B0B43E9C0DDE4455E440ED08B887C:r "HELP TIFFANY’S CAMPAIGN")
---

Murray has been in office for _**three decades**_ and has done **nothing** to stop the rising crime, homelessness, and drug addiction crisis tearing my beloved home state apart.

I'm running for U.S. Senate because Americans deserve better than the failed leadership they've been stuck with for _years_.

It's time for a _**change**_ in D.C., and I'm the right person for the job.

The latest polls in Washington show that my opponent and I will be _**neck and neck**_ , and I'm getting nervous. We're _finally_ closing in on Murray, but I need your support to cross the finish line.

_**[Can you chip in any amount to help me take the lead to save Washington?](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61559689:JCPtieVNc:m:1:3331421248:772B0B43E9C0DDE4455E440ED08B887C:r "Can you chip
in any amount to help me take the lead to save Washington? ")**_

Your support will bring me closer to restoring the American dream from the U.S. Senate.

TIFFANY")
---

To victory,

Tiffany Smiley

Hey, it's Tiffany Smiley.

The Washington Senate race is now the #1 battleground race in the COUNTRY!

Needless to say, all eyes are on us. We are in the FINAL DAYS until the November election, and Patty Murray is flooding millions into our state.

We are in an uphill battle, and I can't make it up to the top without you. Not just Washingtonians, but all Americans deserve a real leader with real solutions. Together, we can ensure that the American Dream is not lost.

_**[Rush support now to be a part of history](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61559690:JCPtieVNc:m:1:3331421248:772B0B43E9C0DDE4455E440ED08B887C:r "Rush support now to be a part of history")**_.

Let's raise money and WIN,

Tiffany Smiley

Team Smiley here with a RED ALERT!

You know we don't often beg, plead, or panic, but Tiffany is facing a key deadline, and we're OUT of time.

Whether or not you choose to act will decide the outcome of the Washington U.S. Senate Election:

Tiffany is currently being outraised and outspent by her 30-year incumbent opponent. We need all hands on deck to turn things around TODAY.

There's no time to wait on the sidelines.

_**[That's why we're HUMBLY asking for your help in the next 15 minutes!](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61559692:JCPtieVNc:m:1:3331421248:772B0B43E9C0DDE4455E440ED08B887C:r "That's why we're HUMBLY asking for

Our team doesn't want to have to deliver bad news to Tiffany later today, so we're calling on our grassroots team, including YOU, to help increase our momentum!

Tiffany is a veterans' advocate and mother of 3! She is the new, fresh leadership we desperately need in Washington! Tiffany will be your #1 supporter in the U.S. Senate.

We're out of time. There's nowhere else to turn. Tiffany needs us at this moment. _**[Step up now!](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61559692:JCPtieVNc:m:1:3331421248:772B0B43E9C0DDE4455E440ED08B887C:r "Step up now!")**_

name: Pramila Jayapal
subject: We have 48 hours to turn this around
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Pramila for Congress
body:
Peter, I’m getting concerned...
#
Peter,
My team briefed me on our fundraising so far this month, our last before one of the most consequential midterm elections of our lifetimes. We’re just 32 days away from Election Day, and I’m getting concerned.
My staff showed me the comparison between our fundraising numbers this time last year and now – and Peter, the difference is honestly shocking. **According to our records, we’re actually down 70% from October of 2021, and we didn’t have an upcoming election then.**
We’re looking at a gap of about $11,137, so if we can make that up, we’ll be back on track and in a better position entering the midterms. This election will decide not just the fate of Congress, but our entire nation – the stakes could not be higher.
70% is a BIG difference, so we set a deadline to raise that $11,137 and close that gap 48 hours from now on Monday. [**Peter, you know I wouldn’t ask if it wasn’t important – so can I count on your donation to get us back on track as we approach Nov 8?**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/18965?refcode=em20221008-1690&t=1&akid=1690%2E420207%2EPooWqu)
**[Contribute $3](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/18965?refcode=em20221008-1690&t=20&akid=1690%2E420207%2EPooWqu)**
From the very start, our campaign has always been powered by donations from a growing grassroots community nationwide. Most of the contributions that we receive from emails like this one are under $27 – **our average is just $25.29**.
One donation of $27 might not seem like it would make a difference, but trust me, every dollar truly adds up – the numbers don’t lie. I am worried about our drop in fundraising, but I’ve seen our movement move mountains.
[**I believe we will make up for this rough patch with support from our people like you – if you can pitch in $27, or any amount, to help us meet our urgent 48-hour deadline, I would greatly appreciate it.**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/18965?refcode=em20221008-1690&t=21&akid=1690%2E420207%2EPooWqu)
Thank you,
Pramila

Growing up in a working family in Brooklyn meant that I didn’t have any power or privilege.

I had no special strings to tug on and no way to stop the manipulative landlords, predatory lenders, and powerful corporations that had ruled New York for generations by taking advantage of families like my own.

When I made history in 2018 by becoming the first Black woman ever to serve as New York’s attorney general, I knew that it was my duty to be the fearless fighter that New Yorkers needed. **I vowed to do everything in my power to finally hold the powerful and corrupt accountable for their actions – and that’s exactly what I’ve done.**

Throughout my time in office, I’ve been able to make a _real_ difference for working families both in New York and beyond, but my fight isn’t over yet. That’s why I’m running for re-election, and I’m counting on your support.

**But, Peter, I’ll be frank: We cannot take anything in this race for granted.** As a Black woman, I learned early in life that nothing is guaranteed.

We can’t afford to give anything less than 110% to this race, _especially_ now that my GOP opponent is accepting massive amounts of money from a far-right “Stop the Steal” conspiracy theorist. Peter, I’m running for Congress to fight for working-class neighborhoods like the one that raised me in Endicott, Broome County. Not the special interests or Wall Street or corporate PACs – who have been corrupting our politics and selling us out for decades.

My family came to the Southern Tier over 100 years ago – working in the local factories where you didn’t need a college degree, just a strong work ethic and respect for your neighbors.

Over time growing up, I saw these good blue-collar jobs leave our town and head overseas where the labor was cheap, and the environment was exploited. It was clear that it was the result of greed in our economy and corruption in our politics.

**So I became an attorney to fight back and stand up for working-class neighborhoods like the one I grew up in.**

In my first case out of law school, I sued the Florida government (before it was popular), arguing that health care should be a civil right, no matter a family’s income.

In the Senate, I took on greedy cable companies looking to execute a merger that would raise costs for families.

In federal court, I argued in favor of ratifying the Equal Rights Amendment, and in the Supreme Court, I challenged the Trump Administration’s discriminatory Muslim Ban.

Now, I’m running for Congress to fight for my hometown and others across our district who have been sold out by career politicians like Marc Molinaro.

clean_body: I’m running for Congress to fight for working-class neighborhoods like the one that raised me in Endicott, Broome County. | = | Peter, I’m going to get personal with you in this email today, and I hope you’ll read it from start to finish. = | = | = Peter, I’m running for Congress to fight for working-class neighborhoods like the one that raised me in Endicott, Broome County. Not the special interests or Wall Street or corporate PACs – who have been corrupting our politics and selling us out for decades. My family came to the Southern Tier over 100 years ago – working in the local factories where you didn’t need a college degree, just a strong work ethic and respect for your neighbors. Over time growing up, I saw these good blue-collar jobs leave our town and head overseas where the labor was cheap, and the environment was exploited. It was clear that it was the result of greed in our economy and corruption in our politics. So I became an attorney to fight back and stand up for working-class neighborhoods like the one I grew up in. In my first case out of law school, I sued the Florida government (before it was popular), arguing that health care should be a civil right, no matter a family’s income. In the Senate, I took on greedy cable companies looking to execute a merger that would raise costs for families. In federal court, I argued in favor of ratifying the Equal Rights Amendment, and in the Supreme Court, I challenged the Trump Administration’s discriminatory Muslim Ban. Now, I’m running for Congress to fight for my hometown and others across our district who have been sold out by career politicians like Marc Molinaro. The good news is that our message is resonating with voters across our 11 counties. But the bad news is that Molinaro’s Super PAC allies just added another $2 million to attack me with baseless lies and try and flip this seat red. = | If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately. | | = | = | = | = | = | = With gratitude & high hopes, Josh Riley * | | Paid for by Josh Riley for Congress Josh Riley for Congress PO Box 6806 213 Tioga St Ithaca, NY 14851 United States | | ---|--- = = If you wish to donate by check, you can make checks payable to Josh Riley for Congress and send to PO Box 6806, 213 Tioga St, Ithaca, NY 14851. Friend, I just got this report from my finance team: **With just hours until my midnight deadline, I'm still $13,293 short of what I need to raise.** Can I please explain to you why this is so important?
Polling shows me _1 point down_ to Marco Rubio in the race that will decide Senate control, and I simply cannot close this polling gap without the grassroots resources to compete against the tens of millions in spending from Mitch McConnell and Rubio.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52237799/371652275/2061369689?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk4666-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84Mzc4NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3ZWNkMzFkNC00MzQ3LWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgyNThkMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=dRXBdkvLk24ROylYakDgSiBEhbC86hVKkgi-RYl_CPw=)

name: Fred Guttenberg via Blue Amp Action
subject: Since my daughter was killed in the Parkland shooting, four years ago, Republicans like Jenn Giroux have worked to end background check protections against arming criminals. Stand with candidates like Rachel Baker, who’ll work to make life safer for our families, not more dangerous.
body:
Most of us support background checks. Republicans won’t listen.
| | | | |
---
| | |
---
| | |
---
| |
---
| | | | | Peter, in a moment, I'm going to ask you to join me in helping Rachel Baker defeat Jenn Giroux, in what is Ohio's most important state legislative race--perhaps one of the most important in the country. **_Four years ago, my daughter Jaime was murdered with an assault weapon in the Parkland massacre. Ever since, Republicans like Jenn Giroux have not only done almost nothing to solve a problem, but, in fact, they've passed legislation in Ohio and other states to allow any criminal or terrorist to carry concealed weapons of war in our streets, by eliminating background checks._** We've seen the results in Uvalde, Buffalo, Highland Park, and in 2019, the Oregon, District of Dayton, Ohio, when nine people out for a fun night on the town were murdered, and 17 others sent to local hospitals with their lives never to be the same. [**This is about saving lives: Will you donate $5, $10, $25 or whatever you can afford to elect Rachel Baker, defeat Jenn Giroux and put us closer to expanding gun safety and abortion rights in Ohio and nationally?**](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tb80d47fa-77eb-4897-aff0-b94a650c5d94/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) **After the awful Supreme Court decision overturning Roe v Wade, Giroux also came out against abortion in all cases--making the ridiculous claim that women never have to choose between their lives and having an abortion. Giroux's combination of extremism and ignorance are both astounding and dangerous. **
---
|
---
| | | | | | [**GIVE NOW >>**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T2b9d6b91-3080-483e-a42f-8bc92af4b5a1/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)
---
| **Luckily, we have a fierce gun safety advocate and former Planned Parenthood employee in Rachel Baker running against her. And why is this so important? Because this district is listed as the most swing seat in Ohio, and if Rachel and four other Democrats win in slightly more Democratic districts, the Republican-gerrymandered supermajority in the state house will end. ** This is crucial, as Nan Whaley has a good chance of being Ohio's next Governor. even if the worst happens and Mike DeWine is reelected, on the few of things where DeWine isn't as crazy as the gerrymandered state house, they won't be able to override his veto. It is also key to getting closer to taking back the state house under the newer lines prescribed by a constitutional amendment to the state constitution. So I'm asking for your help, friend. Jenn Giroux is being supported by the worst right-wing mega-donors and interests spending a ton of money on her behalf. If we can help Rachel Baker overcome the right-wing money and win this race, we'll also helping turn out voters to help elect Whaley, and Democrats Greg Landsman in a swing House seat and Tim Ryan as our U.S. Senator. **_I've often said I consider Ohio a second home, as much of my family lives in the Cincinnati area. But, also, America is my home, and this race will have ripple effects across the country._** [**Please, friend, this is about saving lives: Will you donate $5, $10, $25 or whatever you can afford to elect Rachel Baker, defeat Jenn Giroux and put us closer to expanding gun safety and abortion rights in Ohio and nationally?**](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tbffa38de-8a29-43be-b116-36e8ef2c9c01/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

Fellow American,

When I decided to run for office, I knew I would be attacked. Unfortunately, that's politics these days.

I knew the Left would try to paint me as a man unfit to serve in public office. After all, I struggled with mental health issues when my professional football career ended. This summer, Raphael Warnock and Chuck Schumer's Super PAC spent more than $50 million attacking my character, my family, and my mental health struggles.

**But their ads didn't work.** The personal attacks against me failed to move the needle, so Raphael Warnock and I are neck-and-neck in the polls in the Georgia Senate race.

In their desperation to find something to distract the voters from real issues and blunt our momentum, they came up with an "October Surprise" alleging that I paid for a woman to have an abortion.

**Let me be clear: I have never paid for anyone to have an abortion. It's a flat-out lie.**

We cannot let the Left win by lying, cheating, or buying their way to victory. We need to stand together to fight back with the truth.

Peter,
As Democrat-run cities are besieged by crime and mayhem, Florida is supporting law enforcement and keeping our communities safe.

Far-Left extremists are hell-bent on smearing and defunding the law enforcement officers who risk their lives daily to protect our communities.

Leftist politicians and Soros-backed prosecutors are enabling chaos and undermining the law enforcement profession by letting violent criminals walk free with hardly a slap on the wrist.

In other states, repeat offenders are receiving unlimited "get out of jail free" cards and free rein to disrespect the rule of law. [**_Reject the Left 's woke agenda - Rush in your support >>>_**](http://links.stoppingsocialistdems.com/u/click?_t=4dcc2aab65fd4d0da6a107b0eef86d43&_m=bbba2a3f0a0f4bc88a2f9db23f261e4c&_e=8rJjxuTaCT87aT67KlXOE0y_fFk13t_FJO6otd8ot4w_vZjXUkcAt4ZsJL1s_u7NPHqtkeZ4Mubq3_i9F8pbdghvQ9rOJtbVtYPkWjkQM1zlewnKj65kt6zJi0-G_UCmC2RgR6o1MVnFHNtxkTxZxtsCUiFQ1AVqbp8VSQvELW-Cfg6E_3lupn4X_WAWViJ9OCK2sjGKMUeHnIIRk4bDstiJv-lemh0wxALkH0RWJacsgFvouQMXrKWRD6F1fEWpV40l5L1R1EicO-RL83yX932DKszED-X-pI6So7Pkw9QZwLRX84oFLnEH1u3LcoLsS4vmN2mqc-0awqbd5vdK-UDjLRlB79WAUBrh1mkbtY4%3D)

The Left and their corporate media lapdogs don't want you to see the destruction their woke agenda is inflicting on communities across the nation, so they're doing what they do best: deflecting.

My opponent has not been shy about his support for the reallocation and defunding of police departments. But unlike my opponent and the Soros-funded prosecutors whose pro-crime ideology has made once-great cities unlivable, **I 'm not beholden to anyone but the people of Florida.**

**And as Governor, I have worked to ensure that Florida is a law-and-order state.**

Supporting our law enforcement heroes, pursuing justice for victims, and keeping our communities safe are not Left vs. Right issues. They're right vs. wrong issues - which is why I've been endorsed by Democrat elected officials like Palm Beach County Commissioner Dave Kerner. | Friends,I debated my opponent, Elissa Slotkin, this week and the result is clear _-_ w _e won on policy, substance, and demeanor._ I kept the focus on the issues that matter, like skyrocketing inflation and protecting our children's education. My opponent, who is funded by out-of-state liberal donors to the tune of $16 million, was in constant defense-mode as she struggled to defend an abysmal economic agenda under the Biden administration.
---
[_ _ WATCH THE DEBATE AND DONATE TODAY _ _](https://mgcp02.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=6341e18ddc537c6a087443fc&u=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.winred.com%2Fbarrett-brigade-victory-fund%2Faction-debate%2F&w=618846223a022e7ecb41d30c&l=en-US&s=tGzyhvlReX1b_mqVXI1LugatBtk%3D)
---
My opponent supports taxpayer-funded corporate welfare and tax hikes, while I support tax breaks for working families.**I've stood against taking taxpayer money out of the back pockets of working families in our communities and giving that directly as cash subsidies to private global corporations. It's something I campaigned against and I've committed to the voters of my district I'd oppose.** Our campaign will determine who controls Congress - Nancy Pelosi and the radical Left, or America First Republicans. That's why there's so much attention on this race.I'm not in this fight alone, and we are going to defeat my opponent and her outside dark money because of patriots like you.
---
[_ _ WATCH THE DEBATE AND DONATE TODAY _ _](https://mgcp02.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=6341e18ddc537c6a087443fc&u=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.winred.com%2Fbarrett-brigade-victory-fund%2Faction-debate%2F&w=618846223a022e7ecb41d30c&l=en-US&s=tGzyhvlReX1b_mqVXI1LugatBtk%3D)

Our grassroots campaign is powered by over **26,000 individual donors** , with an average donation of **$78**. Michiganders deserve a fighter who will only answer to them, NOT to Nancy Pelosi or out-of-state liberal donors.We are in a DEAD HEAT and surging. The voters who watched our debate saw a stark contrast -- _a desperate politician backed by dark money struggling to defend the failed Biden economic agenda against a combat veteran with a track record of fighting for working families and against big government._ My opponent has a 100% Biden voting record, which has led to the highest inflation in 40 years, the highest gas prices in history, and out of control illegal immigration with more than 2 million entering the country illegally in the last year alone._We need to get our country back on track_. On [America's Newsroom](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001JYoVQMAb2cl8AphDQkHBmNuu2W32Vw2PX-lFS_qJDbTruFocR-2zp4wydtQ6vuEEvv6_JeRPV4tzKuOyA2h8rcFXrnBxbGQaxHyRBNlyaR4rscbsuZ2KEE_MmOI74PR8QWB-Z_i1bjdUeK7TZUt6WY9SrTTkPV1yWIt5-BWDpkE=&c=AeGC8V3p0xWEAnO2nemc6A4Me2lZC5tdbZHJhASM2OCk2goQ8cGI2w==&ch=jovmJopmsxJOEgqGcPcZggvAi5fMqebQTvgVbmqeUts7KwrMrDIfjA==), Blake talked about his race against Mark Kelly and how inflation and the border have affected Arizona.
Blake joined Dennis Welch on Politics [Unplugged](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001JYoVQMAb2cl8AphDQkHBmNuu2W32Vw2PX-lFS_qJDbTruFocR-2zp4wydtQ6vuEEHJ6FRLmO5ClF5y3ZYuHNxpRcTF9tb-8Gm5hXWvsbBbNQURfRrCypqcM30Z0K4VCrCwGGXsaVxrZi0TcTCMVVg0X1YFOX1heW-BSh3ty3kC_0DQkiyx_pqA==&c=AeGC8V3p0xWEAnO2nemc6A4Me2lZC5tdbZHJhASM2OCk2goQ8cGI2w==&ch=jovmJopmsxJOEgqGcPcZggvAi5fMqebQTvgVbmqeUts7KwrMrDIfjA==) for a wide-ranging profile interview.
On [Hannity](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001JYoVQMAb2cl8AphDQkHBmNuu2W32Vw2PX-lFS_qJDbTruFocR-2zp4wydtQ6vuEEQzI44ggwvB4dNVGp04Z9mOTlywuvasuIdkgvYhrUH7SmDvV25GIX2T563yiZFj7hzbGTsa7Ta_8_c-bBUttoQqXItF69r3vXzpidgNXlZFFT2Bx-ZGrDtg==&c=AeGC8V3p0xWEAnO2nemc6A4Me2lZC5tdbZHJhASM2OCk2goQ8cGI2w==&ch=jovmJopmsxJOEgqGcPcZggvAi5fMqebQTvgVbmqeUts7KwrMrDIfjA==), Blake talked about the state of his race and Mark Kelly's failures.

Reported in [Breitbart](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001JYoVQMAb2cl8AphDQkHBmNuu2W32Vw2PX-lFS_qJDbTruFocR-2zpzZd3nsKx9dgvKrEB0F5TjgLnhgGH4xjauZ7YuqofxvLLyLQ2Q0K6TuI6y4Y7TnQRyQTK-e0Tu3i96IYh_aF4yqnlmu3O6FuGHJEsZUKf3Uv28z4kaGrz1TzZzH9E3YtbXY8ZVKYjXrOgc5BfjbsdGimxFGnr4bfDE5a95hXPPZEntjsXxFNoRx0IwodmBhKpQ_IkjGQUgUz&c=AeGC8V3p0xWEAnO2nemc6A4Me2lZC5tdbZHJhASM2OCk2goQ8cGI2w==&ch=jovmJopmsxJOEgqGcPcZggvAi5fMqebQTvgVbmqeUts7KwrMrDIfjA==), Blake's recent visit to the border caught national attention when he slammed Kamala Harris for saying the border is secure.
On his [national radio show](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001JYoVQMAb2cl8AphDQkHBmNuu2W32Vw2PX-lFS_qJDbTruFocR-2zp4wydtQ6vuEER7J7UoHmsKeziImA4645fadUDq2QVYkb2pVA4IFU5eiDK4jLNo5BxsqZ1dkSbzaSULxOfQ7m-xMMFjgoPxTV98DEagqp-WNw7F_osboSPAf0FvbYQC4mQMTPvQ4nQfTD3DQKs-wYLV0WZe8ov7yiDSudUodIKlNV5RHGqVvHqHunPSLrH4Axsg==&c=AeGC8V3p0xWEAnO2nemc6A4Me2lZC5tdbZHJhASM2OCk2goQ8cGI2w==&ch=jovmJopmsxJOEgqGcPcZggvAi5fMqebQTvgVbmqeUts7KwrMrDIfjA==), Hugh Hewitt recapped the recent Arizona Senate debate. Hugh's conclusion: Blake eviscerated Kelly.

name: Harmeet Dhillon
subject: You can't be trusted..
body:
| | | Peter, Imagine that you've just been called into the middle school principal's office to have a "serious talk" about your daughter. You're worried -- is it her grades? Her behavior? Is she hurt? Instead, the principal tells you that your daughter -- your 12- year-old little girl -- is now your son. That behind your back, the school has been "educating" your preteen daughter \-- for months, in total secret -- about how to "transition" her gender. And they instructed her to keep it hidden from you...because you "can't be trusted." That you, her parent, are not "safe." But now, she has a new name. New pronouns. A new bathroom. And you just need to accept it. _Wouldn 't you be furious?_ I know I would be! So it's no surprise that's exactly how Jessica Konen felt when she was called into her daughter's California middle school and this nightmare played out in real life. **Now, Jessica is fighting back and suing the school district -- plus the principal and the two teachers who "groomed" her daughter -- and she needs your help to win justice in a court of law. ** [**Will you please make an urgent, tax-deductible donation to the Center for American Liberty and help us fund this lawsuit while generating a nationwide wave of support for Jessica and her daughter?**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61558077:6WrvPeVNr:m:1:3253819041:1BA004B512112786397AF400440BEDE8:r) I hope you will, because as infuriating as that story is, the details are even more outrageous. Would you believe Jessica's daughter was just eleven when she was lured by these teachers to join their so-called "Equality Club"? **_They first convinced this little girl that she was bisexual. Then, as they sunk their hooks deeper, they told her -- not long after her twelfth birthday -- that really, she was probably "transgender." _** "But don't tell your parents!" they warned. In fact, they operated the entire club under a cloak of secrecy. No permission slips were signed. No attendance was taken. No membership lists were kept. Meetings were scheduled for lunchtime -- instead of after school, like other clubs -- so parents wouldn't begin to wonder where their kids were. What were they hiding?? If you've followed the growing nationwide problem of teachers "grooming" young, confused students -- you probably know some of the predatory tactics these teachers often use to manipulate vulnerable children into believing they're "transgender" or "non-binary." This case was no exception. In fact, these two teachers even let some of their secrets slip on leaked audio from a Teachers Association conference! Discussing how they managed to target so many new recruits for their club, one of the teachers confessed: "We totally stalked what they were doing on Google." **These teachers zeroed in on confused and troubled students and -- instead of helping them -- they further filled these children 's heads with lies and more confusion. ** [**Which is why I 'm asking you to make an urgent donation of $35 or more today if you agree with our lawsuit against these teachers, the principal, and the Spreckels Union School District.**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61558077:6WrvPeVNr:m:1:3253819041:1BA004B512112786397AF400440BEDE8:r) My name is Harmeet Dhillon. I'm a lawyer, and the founder of the Center for American Liberty. You may recognize me from one of my many Fox News appearances with Jessica Konen or other plaintiffs my nonprofit organization is representing in lawsuits against government officials who violate Americans' rights. Today, I'm asking you to join us in support of Jessica's case. It's clear that the defendants deprived Jessica Konen of her civil rights as a parent, that they conspired to do so, and that they inflicted emotional distress on both Jessica and her daughter. Those legal claims and more are at the heart of our lawsuit. I believe our evidence lays out a very strong case. But you must remember, this is a California school district and the defense's case will be funded by the government. And it will pay whatever it takes to defend leftist ideologies. [**That 's why, I hope you'll also consider making a generous donation of $25, $35, $50 or $100 to help fund our case. **](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61558077:6WrvPeVNr:m:1:3253819041:1BA004B512112786397AF400440BEDE8:r) The Center for American Liberty is a nonprofit organization, meaning we receive no government funding -- _unlike the deep-pocketed defendants in most of our cases._ Because of this, we rely on support from generous Americans who can recognize an injustice and want to see it set right. Our nonprofit status also means your donation is tax-deductible to the fullest extent allowed by law. We've seen evidence of this type of "grooming" at schools across the country. And it's not just in places like California! Dangerous teachers like this are unfortunately in classrooms across the country. Thankfully, the tide seems to be turning against them. Earlier this year, Governor DeSantis outlawed teachers from having these sexualized conversations with their young students. And elsewhere, parents have gotten involved with their local school boards to run for office and change policies that have put radical gender ideology ahead of student safety or parental rights. Those are political solutions. **Ours is a legal one.** And I believe that, in order to fully purge this predatory behavior from our schools, we need to fight this battle on all available fronts. Won't you please help us win this fight in a court of law?**[Join the fight with a generous donation of $35 or more so the courts, the plaintiffs, the defendants -- everybody -- will know how big the nationwide movement to protect kids has grown. ](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61558077:6WrvPeVNr:m:1:3253819041:1BA004B512112786397AF400440BEDE8:r)** ** ** No parent should have to endure what Jessica Konen and her daughter did, and it's up to us to use the full force of the law to make sure no teacher is allowed to get away with this again. Thank you,

Fellow American,

When I decided to run for office, I knew I would be attacked. Unfortunately, that's politics these days.

I knew the Left would try to paint me as a man unfit to serve in public office. After all, I struggled with mental health issues when my professional football career ended. But I sought treatment, got help, and then spent the next decade encouraging others to get help if they needed it. In fact, I even wrote a book about my journey, _Breaking Free: My Life with Dissociated Identity Disorder_ , with the goal of helping others.

This summer, Raphael Warnock and Chuck Schumer's Super PAC spent more than $50 million attacking my character, my family, and my mental health struggles.

**But their ads didn't work.** The personal attacks against me failed to move the needle, so Raphael Warnock and I are neck-and-neck in the polls in the Georgia Senate race.

In their desperation to find something to distract the voters from real issues and blunt our momentum, they came up with an "October Surprise" alleging that I paid for a woman to have an abortion.

**Let me be clear: I have never paid for anyone to have an abortion. It's a flat-out lie.**

We cannot let the Left win by lying, cheating, or buying their way to victory. We need to stand together to fight back with the truth.

**[Fellow American, today I need your assistance more than ever before in this campaign. subject: I know firsthand
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Beto for Texas
body:
[1]Beto O'Rourke

Hi, it's
Wendy Davis.

You may know me from my 13-hour filibuster as a Texas State Senator. When
Republicans wanted to close almost every clinic that provided abortion
care in Texas, I laced up my sneakers because I firmly believe in every
woman’s right to make her own decisions about her own body.

But what you may not know is that in 2014, I ran against Greg Abbott for
Governor. So, you can trust me when I say that Beto needs all of the
support we can offer him right now.

I know firsthand how much money Abbott will pour into this race to crush
our grassroots momentum, so with 31 days until Election Day, I'm asking:
[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=bft-em-20221008-2.us6g6R&refcode=ema20221008-211599&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1001&akid=211599%2E444211%2ERS-ESs ]Will
you please give anything you can right now to power Beto's campaign to
defeat Abbott? If we don't win, Texans will lose.

Like so many women, I knew to expect the overturning of Roe v. Wade, but
on the day the decision came down, I still felt a crushing disbelief.

Because of Roe, I was able to make decisions born of love for my family
when faced with an ectopic pregnancy, and later, a fatal fetal abnormality
in a much-wanted pregnancy. What will happen to other families who
confront similar and very personal health care decisions?

We know what they’ll face in Greg Abbott's Texas where abortion is
outlawed, even in cases of rape or incest. I am filled with sadness
knowing that my two granddaughters are growing up in a state that does not
guarantee them the right to make their own health care decisions.

But even in the face of this crisis, I still cling to the belief that we
possess the power to make a positive impact and to change the course for
the better. Across the state, Texans are showing us they're ready for
change. Young Democrats are registering to vote in huge numbers, and Beto
is keeping this a close race!

Beto has committed to protecting women’s freedom to make decisions about
our own bodies. As governor, he will fight to repeal Abbott's extreme
abortion ban and restore reproductive rights. I'm supporting Beto for
governor because this is a matter of life or death for Texans — will you
join me?

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=bft-em-20221008-2.us6g6R&refcode=ema20221008-211599&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=211599%2E444211%2ERS-ESs ]Please make a contribution now to end Abbott's cruelty and extremism.
Beto needs our grassroots support to win on November 8.

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=bft-em-20221008-2.us6g6R&refcode=ema20221008-211599&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1021&akid=211599%2E444211%2ERS-ESs ]Contribute $3

Never lose hope,

Wendy

name: Mark Kelly
subject: Donald Trump is coming back
disclaimer_text: Paid for by VPP
body:
This Sunday, Donald Trump is coming back to Arizona. He knows how important this state is, and he knows how important our race is.
| Friends --

In less than one day, Donald Trump is coming back to Arizona and my opponent will be right on stage with him. Trump knows how important this state is, and how important our race is.

That’s why at one of his previous rallies here, he said: “Taking America back begins with kicking Mark Kelly the hell out of the United States Senate.”

And the truth is, if we don’t have the resources we need to win this race, he might get his wish. Millions of dollars have already been spent trying to defeat us, and millions more are coming. If Trump can help flip this seat, he’ll be that much more likely to run in 2024. He might even win.

Sorry to put that thought in your head, but it’s true.

That’s why I need to know if you can make a $10 contribution before Trump arrives. Because when he does, a lot of people from the far right are going to look more closely at this race and pour money into Arizona to try to beat me.

So, I’m humbly asking:

[Can you please split a $10 contribution between our campaign and Voter Protection Project to help us defend this seat? It all adds up when everyone is chipping in. That’s how we win.](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/28852?t=6&akid=4849%2E878179%2E8dIyOO) If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation to Mark Kelly and Voter Protection Project will go through immediately: | [CONTRIBUTE $10 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/28853?t=7&akid=4849%2E878179%2E8dIyOO)

They got me through college (the first in my family to do so), through my 27 years on the police force, through my first term as a U.S. Congresswoman, and now, through this uphill battle to the Senate. name: Bernie Sanders
subject: I am urgently asking you to contribute $3 to Mandela Barnes' campaign. He can flip Wisconsin's Senate seat, but only with your support. So please, chip in today. This is important.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Mandela Barnes for Wisconsin
body:
#
Sisters and Brothers -
At this moment in American history — in the midst of massive income and wealth inequality, a global pandemic, the existential threat of climate change and major attacks against our democratic foundations — it has never been more important to elect candidates who will fight for a strong, pro-worker agenda.
We need to support tough candidates who will take on corporate greed, authoritarianism, and bigotry, and who are prepared to fight for justice. In order to do that, we must bring our people together in a multi-generational, multi-racial movement to take on the big-money interests that have so much political and economic power in our country.
**That is why I am writing to you today to ask you to make a $3 contribution to Mandela Barnes' U.S. Senate campaign in Wisconsin.**
Mandela is an excellent candidate whose victory will not only help Democrats retain control of the Senate, but will give us a strong voice fighting for working families.
Right now, within our corrupt campaign finance system, Mandela is up against tens of millions of dollars from right-wing super PACs that are running grossly dishonest attack ads trying to defeat him. We cannot allow these billionaire-funded super PACs to succeed, which is why I need to ask:
[**Can you please make a $3 contribution to Mandela Barnes today? He is counting on lots of donations to fund his campaign for Senate between now and Election Day.**](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=mandela-em-oct22.Zk_Uo1&refcode=em221008-1-acq-sp2&t=1&akid=3488%2E196590%2EmobnqG)
_If you 've saved payment info with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_
[Express Donate: $3](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1272?c0=mandela-em-oct22.R5mi9l&refcode=em221008-1-acq-sp2&t=20&akid=3488%2E196590%2EmobnqG)
[Express Donate: $25](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1273?c0=mandela-em-oct22.EgXJNr&refcode=em221008-1-acq-sp2&t=21&akid=3488%2E196590%2EmobnqG)
[Express Donate: $50](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1274?c0=mandela-em-oct22.9S-_mg&refcode=em221008-1-acq-sp2&t=22&akid=3488%2E196590%2EmobnqG)
[Express Donate: $100](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1275?c0=mandela-em-oct22.vyE4YF&refcode=em221008-1-acq-sp2&t=23&akid=3488%2E196590%2EmobnqG)
[Express Donate: $250](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1266?c0=mandela-em-oct22.TLNN8P&refcode=em221008-1-acq-sp2&t=24&akid=3488%2E196590%2EmobnqG)
[Or donate another amount](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=mandela-em-oct22.Zk_Uo1&refcode=em221008-1-acq-sp2&t=25&akid=3488%2E196590%2EmobnqG)
Mandela is a candidate who will have the guts to take on powerful special interests and challenge the status quo if elected to the Senate.
He is the son of a Milwaukee public school teacher and a UAW assembly line worker. Both of his parents were active union members who organized for better wages, benefits and working conditions.
From a very young age, Mandela saw the power of grassroots organizing and what is possible when people come together to challenge the status quo. It's what led him to run for state representative, and then for Lieutenant Governor of Wisconsin.
As Lieutenant Governor he has led efforts across the state to address the climate crisis, and enable Wisconsin to respond effectively to the COVID pandemic. Now Mandela is running for Senate because he believes that it's time to prioritize the needs of working people and take on powerful special interests.
Let’s be clear. We are living in a time where the 1% is doing phenomenally well, while working people are falling further and further behind. Now is the time to stand up and fight back, and Mandela will be an important ally in that struggle.
The November midterm elections are enormously important. They will determine whether we go forward fighting for the long-neglected needs of working families, or continue the drift toward oligarchy and authoritarianism.
Mandela is counting on strong grassroots support in order to fund his campaign during these critical final weeks before the election. So I am asking:
[**Can you please make a $3 contribution to Mandela Barnes' campaign for Senate today? He is running in one of the most important races in the country, and he urgently needs your support.**](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=mandela-em-oct22.Zk_Uo1&refcode=em221008-1-acq-sp2&t=26&akid=3488%2E196590%2EmobnqG)
Right now our job must be to elect more leaders who are prepared to stand up for working families and take on big-money interests.
Your contribution to Mandela Barnes today will help ensure we have a crucial vote in the Senate to pass legislation that could transform this country. Thank you for chipping in today, if you can afford it.
In solidarity,
Bernie Sanders

We cannot allow these billionaire-funded super PACs to succeed, which is why I need to ask: If you 've saved payment info with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: Mandela is a candidate who will have the guts to take on powerful special interests and challenge the status quo if elected to the Senate. He is the son of a Milwaukee public school teacher and a UAW assembly line worker. Both of his parents were active union members who organized for better wages, benefits and working conditions. From a very young age, Mandela saw the power of grassroots organizing and what is possible when people come together to challenge the status quo. It's what led him to run for state representative, and then for Lieutenant Governor of Wisconsin. As Lieutenant Governor he has led efforts across the state to address the climate crisis, and enable Wisconsin to respond effectively to the COVID pandemic. Now Mandela is running for Senate because he believes that it's time to prioritize the needs of working people and take on powerful special interests. Let’s be clear. We are living in a time where the 1% is doing phenomenally well, while working people are falling further and further behind. Now is the time to stand up and fight back, and Mandela will be an important ally in that struggle. The November midterm elections are enormously important. They will determine whether we go forward fighting for the long-neglected needs of working families, or continue the drift toward oligarchy and authoritarianism. Mandela is counting on strong grassroots support in order to fund his campaign during these critical final weeks before the election. So I am asking: Right now our job must be to elect more leaders who are prepared to stand up for working families and take on big-money interests. Your contribution to Mandela Barnes today will help ensure we have a crucial vote in the Senate to pass legislation that could transform this country. Thank you for chipping in today, if you can afford it. In solidarity, Bernie Sanders
